Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Ready to turn complex data into powerful insights that shape the future of home improvement? Join Wickes as our new Senior Data Analyst.




Role Purpose:

At Wickes, we’re on a mission to create simple, digital-first experiences that help our customers build, repair, and improve their homes. Behind every great project is great data. As our new Senior Data Analyst, you’ll be at the heart of our data-driven decision-making, supporting various departments with advanced analytics, decision support, MI scoping, and hands-on training.




This role is based in Watford with occasional travel to Northampton.




What you’ll be doing:

Deep Dive Analysis: Deliver detailed, relevant insights that empower business areas to make smart, impactful decisions.
Data Lake Development: Collaborate with key stakeholders and fellow analysts to shape the development of our Data Lake, recommending and implementing robust analytical solutions.
Reporting & Governance: Own data tables management, manage business rules and logic, and ensure top-tier data quality assurance, accuracy, and confidentiality across all systems.
Empowering the Business: Support company reporting needs, maintain robust processes for team best practice, and champion super-user "spokes" across the business to foster self-sufficiency.
Documentation & Training: Create user manuals, documentation, and training materials that translate complex IT and data concepts into clear, accessible guidance for non-technical colleagues.




What we’re looking for:

Relevant professional or industry training, including advanced SQL and Data Analysis.
5+ years of BI and data experience, with a strong background in business partnering.




Skills & Technical Knowledge

Expert proficiency with BI tools and cloud data warehouse technologies (e.g., BigQuery), with confidence handling large datasets.
Strong understanding of SQL databases, star and snowflake schema modelling, and building both basic and complex queries.
Functional and technical competence in Google reporting and data warehouse architecture.
Exceptional communication skills, capable of explaining complex data simply, managing projects end-to-end, and providing first-line user support and triage.
Collaborative team player who is energetic, proactive, well-organised, and responsive to competing priorities.




What can we offer you?

You’ll be supported with fantastic learning and development and have the opportunity to grow and develop your career with us. We also have an early careers network to support you if you’re in your first few years of your career.




We’ll also equip you with a benefits package that includes:

Competitive bonus
Save-as-you-earn scheme
Private Medical and Life Assurance
Enhanced contributory pension scheme
Colleague discount




Discount platform including savings and cash back at numerous retailers, savings on gym membership, cycle to work scheme

Our widely recognised wellbeing strategy is something we’re proud of at Wickes. As part of this, we offer a range of health and wellbeing benefits and support, including an Employee Assistance Programme, financial education & loans, and access to parental, menopause and fertility support.

By giving you the support you need to do well at work, and the flexibility to make life work for you. We are giving you a career that doesn’t put your life on hold. Where you can be yourself, do your best work, and make a positive difference every day.




About Us:

Wickes is a multi-channel retailer operating in the home improvement market. With 50 years in industry, Wickes now generates revenue in excess of £1.6bn across 230 stores delivered by 8,000+ colleagues. But it is our culture that is considered our best kept secret; it’s a collaborative, down to earth, fun and inclusive environment where people feel part of a winning team. All our colleagues come from different backgrounds, but what we all have in common is a determination to succeed and a passion for being the best we can be. If that sounds like you, we’ll make you feel right at home.




We aim to create an inclusive workplace with colleagues’ wellbeing at the heart of everything we do.




We’re a Disability Confident Employer and committed to building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome applications from disabled people and are committed to providing an accessible recruitment process and workplace for everyone. If you require any support or reasonable adjustments, please let us know here.

Description:
Must hold a valid Security Clearance




As a Senior Data Analyst at Made Tech, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping public sector organisations become truly data-led. You’ll join our data team in its mission to get data knowledge and skills out of silos and embedded into delivery teams. You will provide advanced data modelling, predictive analytics, and data visualisation, allowing us to deliver more sophisticated and customised solutions to our clients.




The role is very hands-on and you'll support as a senior contributor role for a project, focusing on:

Data analysis and reporting: Conducting in-depth data analysis, generating reports, and providing actionable insights for client projects.
Data and BI visualisation: Producing BI dashboards using industry-standard tools - Power BI, Tableau, Quicksight etc
Client interaction: Collaborating with clients to understand their needs, translating these into analytical solutions, and presenting findings in a clear, actionable manner.
Mentoring junior analysts, leading data-focused projects, and setting best practices in data analysis

Key responsibilities

Analysis and synthesis

Application of analytical techniques: Proficiency in applying various analytical methods such as statistical analysis, data mining, and qualitative analysis. Ability to select and apply appropriate techniques based on the context and research data.
Synthesis of research data: Experience in synthesising research data to present actionable insights and solutions. Ability to articulate the impact of their analysis on decision-making and problem-solving.
Engagement with sceptical colleagues: Effective communication and persuasion skills to engage and gain buy-in from sceptical colleagues. Ability to foster collaboration and address concerns to ensure adherence to best practices.
Advisory and critique skills: Capability to advise on the choice and application of analytical techniques and critique colleagues' findings to ensure high standards in data analysis.

Data Management

Understanding of data sources and storage: Knowledge of various data sources, data organisation, and storage practices. Commitment to maintaining data integrity and accessibility.
Advocacy for data governance: Experience in advocating for data governance standards and influencing team adherence to data quality practices.
Continuous improvement: Ability to communicate and implement continuous improvements in data management practices through documentation, training, and regular team engagement.
Toolset management: Proficiency in defining and supporting common toolsets for data management, ensuring efficiency and seamless integration.
Automation of data management: Experience in automating data management activities to streamline processes and increase accuracy. (desirable)
Compliance with data governance policies: Understanding and ensuring compliance with data governance policies, maintaining data security and ethical standards.

Data modelling, cleansing, and enrichment

Data modelling expertise: Proficient in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling. Ability to adhere to data modelling standards and best practices.
Data cleansing and standardisation: Experience in resolving data quality issues and ensuring data accuracy through cleansing and standardisation techniques.
Use of data integration tools: Skilled in using ETL tools for data integration and storage. Ensures data interoperability with other datasets.
Collaboration with data professionals: Experience collaborating with other data professionals to improve modelling and integration standards and patterns.

Data Visualisation

Interpretation of requirements: Ability to interpret data visualisation requirements and create meaningful, visually appealing representations tailored to the audience.
Proficiency in visualisation tools: Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and Python libraries like Matplotlib and Seaborn. Knowledge of selecting appropriate visualisation types.
Application of visualisation standards: Application of design principles to create clear, accurate, and accessible visualisations. Awareness of accessibility considerations.
Mentorship in visualisation: Experience in reviewing and advising junior members to improve the quality and efficiency of data visualisations.

Data Quality Assurance, Validation, and Linkage

Data quality assurance: Experience in implementing processes for data quality assessment and improvement, including data profiling, cleansing, and standardisation.
Data validation and linkage: Ability to perform data validation checks and integrate data from various sources to ensure consistency and accuracy.
Data cleansing and preparation: Proficiency in defining data cleansing processes and preparing data for analysis by handling missing values, outliers, and duplicates.
Communication of data limitations: Skilled in articulating data constraints and limitations to stakeholders, providing context for informed decision-making.
Peer review and quality control: Experience in conducting peer reviews to validate data outputs, ensuring high standards of accuracy and reliability.

Statistical Methods and Data Analysis

Knowledge of statistical methodologies: Proficient in various statistical methods, such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, clustering, and time series analysis. Ability to select appropriate techniques based on project requirements.
Data analysis and interpretation: Experience in using statistical software or programming languages to perform data analysis and generate insights. Skilled in communicating findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Application of emerging theory: Willingness to explore and apply new statistical methodologies or practices to solve practical problems and adapt to emerging theories.

Skills, knowledge and expertise

Communication

Stakeholder communication: Experience in effectively engaging with a diverse range of stakeholders, including technical and business individuals. Ability to manage expectations and facilitate productive discussions.
Active and reactive communication: Proficiency in handling both proactive communication (updates, insights) and reactive communication (responding to inquiries, addressing concerns) to maintain a collaborative atmosphere.
Interpretation of stakeholder needs: Ability to understand and translate stakeholder requirements into technical solutions. Experience in bridging the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Presentation and sharing of insights: Skilled in presenting complex data in a clear, understandable manner tailored to diverse audiences, including senior management.

Logical and creative thinking

Problem-solving approach: Ability to apply logical and creative thinking to resolve complex problems by breaking them down and generating innovative solutions.
Decision-making and action-taking: Skilled in making informed decisions, prioritising tasks, and taking appropriate actions to resolve issues efficiently.
Adaptability and learning orientation: Demonstrates adaptability in strategies and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
Interpretation of stakeholder needs: Ability to understand and translate stakeholder requirements into technical solutions. Experience in bridging the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Presentation and sharing of insights: Skilled in presenting complex data in a clear, understandable manner tailored to diverse audiences, including senior management.

Job benefits

We’re committed to building a happy, inclusive and diverse workforce. You can get a sense of what it’s like working here from our blog, where we talk about mental health, communities of practice and neurodiversity (as well as our client work and best practice).




Like many organisations, we use Slack to chat to each other. The Slack groups that have formed give an idea of the diversity within Made Tech. disability

women-in-tech

We've recently introduced a flexible benefit platform which includes a Smart Tech scheme, Cycle to work scheme, and an individual benefits allowance which you can invest in a Health care cash plan or Pension plan. We’re also big on connection and have an optional social and wellbeing calendar of events for all employees to join should they choose to.

• Design and analyse experiments to measure what actually works

• Analyse complex operational problems and identify key performance levers

• Build risk scores, segmentation and performance frameworks

• Partner with Product, Ops and Engineering to shape the analytics roadmap

• Turn data into decisions that have a direct impact on daily operations




What they’re looking for:

• Strong, advanced SQL skills

• Experience with experimentation / A/B testing

• Strong analytical problem-solving and commercial thinking

• Experience with product, operational or performance analytics

• Comfortable working autonomously and influencing non-technical stakeholders

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.




THE TEAM

• ~110 people, more than half in engineering, product and data

• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research

• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle

• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation




The Opportunity

Relay’s Last Mile network runs on couriers - tens of thousands of them, doing real work in the physical world every day. Whether each parcel gets delivered successfully depends on the decisions and behaviours of the courier on route. We're hiring for a Senior Data Analyst to own how Relay measures and improves courier excellence: how we shape what happens on the doorstep, and how we manage performance before and after that interaction.

This role works with the whole of the Last Mile team and partners closely with data scientists, engineers and operators across the squad. There's a v1 of performance management already running; you'll own its evolution into something materially better.




Last Mile

Handover Optimisation: Every handover is a trade-off between competing outcomes - speed, quality, and risk. Moving any one of them can have knock-on effects on the others, and finding the right balance is one of the most interesting analytical problems in the network. Your job is to make those trade-offs visible, model them, and find the levers that move the network in the right direction. You'll run the experiments, design the measurement, and quantify what actually works.

Performance Management: Relay already has a framework for measuring courier performance, and it feeds into how work is distributed. The job now is to ensure it drives fleet quality - defining the right behaviours to measure, evaluating the interventions designed to help couriers shift those behaviours, and closing the loop so the framework continuously improves. You'll partner with product, ops and engineering across this work, with the analytics owned by you.

Courier-facing analytics: Couriers are the end users of much of this work. You'll think about how performance and rewards are made transparent to them, and you'll run experiments to evaluate whether interventions are actually working for couriers and for Relay.




Who Will Thrive in This Role

You're a strong analyst who thinks in systems. You break complex problems into components and know where the real opportunity lies.
You are successful working with high autonomy and are excited to operate in a Product/Programme Manager like capacity, defining the roadmap as well as executing against it.
You care about solving the problem more than which techniques you use.
You love working with smart, motivated people.
You're fluent in SQL.
You're comfortable across the analytical spectrum - designing and reading experiments, building risk scores and segmentation, and shipping descriptive analysis that drives a decision the same week.
You communicate inclusively with non-technical team members.
You love seeing the impact of your work play out in a daily operation.
Bonus: You have experience working on performance management, marketplace quality, operational analytics or another relevant domain.




Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.
Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.
25 days of holidays
Enhanced parental leave.
Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.
Hardware of your choice.
Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).




Who Thrives at Relay?

Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.
Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.
1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.
All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.
People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.
Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Do you want to use data to shape decisions across the global research communications industry?




Do you thrive on leading stakeholders from a business question to a data-driven action?

Location: London or Oxford

About Our Team




The Scientific, Technical & Medical Journals (STMJ) business, part of Elsevier, provides researchers with a trusted platform to publish and share their work. Publishing research across approximately 3,000 journals annually, STMJ plays a critical role in advancing scientific discovery and knowledge dissemination worldwide.




The STMJ Data & Analytics team is a global group of data professionals dedicated to delivering high-quality insights and analytics that enable data-driven decision-making. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, the team transforms complex data into actionable recommendations that drive performance, innovation, and customer value.




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our STMJ Data & Analytics team. You will act as a trusted thought partner to stakeholders, leading complex analytics initiatives, independently managing projects, and helping to shape business decisions through data.




As a senior member of the team, you will work with a high degree of autonomy, serve as a subject matter expert, and support the development of junior analysts through coaching and knowledge sharing. You'll join a large, established team of data professionals that supports STMJ, with direct access to enterprise-grade platforms and tools, and be a part of a wider Elsevier organisation that's a global leader in information and analytics, helping researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes worldwide.




Responsibilities




Lead complex analytics projects from planning through delivery, translating loosely defined business problems into a clear plan of action.
Act as a trusted thought partner to senior stakeholders, shaping strategy, guiding them through hypothesis driven thinking, and challenging assumptions through data.
Identify and execute the most relevant analyses, metrics, and reporting solutions.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while effectively prioritising workload.
Collaborate with cross-functional business and technical teams to overcome challenges and deliver results.
Continuously adapt to new tools and technologies, evaluating and adopting emerging techniques, including AI-assisted analytics, as the field evolves.
Coach and mentor junior data analysts, sharing best practices and analytical expertise.




Requirements




Demonstrated ability to influence decision-making through data-backed recommendations.
Proven experience managing projects and delivering results independently.
Good understanding of core analytics concepts, such as data modelling, blending, and visualization.
Experience balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Comfort operating in a fast-changing technical landscape and learning new tools, technologies, and analytical methodologies.
Experience within scholarly communications, publishing, or a related industry is advantageous but not essential.




Applicants must include a cover letter. This should clearly describe your interest in the role and how your skills, knowledge, and experience would contribute to the journal. Applications that do not include a cover letter will not be reviewed.




Work in a way that works for you




We promote a healthy work-life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people, with numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and flexible working arrangements to help you meet your personal and professional goals.




Working for you




We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:




Generous holiday allowance
Health and wellbeing benefits
Pension and savings plans
Life assurance and income protection
Flexible and hybrid working options
Employee assistance programmes
Learning and development opportunities




About Us




A global leader in information and analytics, Elsevier helps researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. Our innovative solutions combine world-class scientific information with technology and analytics to help make research more effective and impactful.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Must hold valid SC Clearance




Made Tech wants to positively impact the country's future by using technology to improve society, for everyone. We want to empower the public sector to deliver and continuously improve digital services that are user-centric, data-driven and freed from legacy technology. A key component of this is developing modern data systems and platforms that drive informed decision-making for our clients. You will also work closely with clients to help shape their data strategy.




Key Responsibilities

As a Data Analyst, you may play one or more roles according to our clients' needs. The role is very hands-on and you'll support as contributor for a project, focusing on:

Data analysis and reporting: Conducting in-depth data analysis, generating reports, and providing actionable insights for client projects.
Data and BI visualisation: Producing BI dashboards using industry-standard tools - Power BI, Tableau, Quicksight etc
Client interaction: Collaborating with clients to understand their needs, translating these into analytical solutions, and presenting findings in a clear, actionable manner.

You’ll need to have a drive to deliver outcomes for users. You’ll make sure that the wider context of a delivery is considered and maintain alignment between the operational and analytical aspects of the engineering solution.




Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Analysis and synthesis

Application of analytical techniques: Proficiency in applying various analytical methods such as statistical analysis, data mining, and qualitative analysis. Ability to select and apply appropriate techniques based on the context and research data.
Synthesis of research data: Experience in synthesising research data to present actionable insights and solutions. Ability to articulate the impact of their analysis on decision-making and problem-solving.
Engagement with sceptical colleagues: Effective communication skills to engage and gain buy-in from sceptical colleagues.




Data Management

Good understanding of data sources and storage: Familiarity with common data sources and general knowledge of data organisation and storage practices. Willingness to maintain data accuracy and accessibility.
Awareness of data governance: Understanding of data governance standards and a commitment to following data quality practices set by the team.
Continuous improvement: Ability to contribute to improvements in data management practices by supporting documentation, learning from team training, and actively participating in discussions.
Toolset support: Experience with using data management tools, with a willingness to learn more about maintaining efficiency and integration.
Interest in automation: An interest in learning how to automate data management activities to streamline processes and improve accuracy (desirable).
Compliance with data governance policies: Basic understanding of data governance policies, with a focus on following data security and ethical standards.




Data modelling, cleansing, and enrichment

Data cleansing and standardisation: Experience in resolving data quality issues and ensuring data accuracy through cleansing and standardisation techniques.
Exposure to data integration tools: Basic experience with ETL tools for data integration and storage, with a focus on learning how to ensure data interoperability with other datasets.
Collaboration with data professionals: Some experience working with other data professionals, with a focus on learning and improving data modelling and integration practices through teamwork.




Data Visualisation

Understanding visualisation requirements: Ability to understand data visualisation needs and create simple, visually appealing representations suited to the audience.
Good working knowledge of visualisation tools: Experience using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Python libraries (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn), with a willingness to learn how to choose the right visualisation type for different data sets.
Awareness of visualisation standards: Understanding of design principles to create clear and accurate visualisations, with an interest in learning about accessibility best practices.
Willingness to learn from peers: Open to feedback and guidance from senior team members to improve the quality of your visualisations.




Data Quality Assurance, Validation, and Linkage

Data quality assurance: Familiarity with data quality assessment techniques, such as data profiling and cleansing, with a willingness to learn more about improving data accuracy and consistency.
Data validation and linkage: Experience performing basic data validation checks and combining data from different sources, with guidance from senior team members.
Data cleansing and preparation: Experience in data preparation, including handling missing values and duplicates, with a focus on learning more advanced data cleansing techniques.
Communication of data limitations: Ability to discuss data limitations with guidance from others, helping stakeholders understand potential issues and make informed decisions.
Participating in peer reviews: Willingness to participate in peer reviews to improve data accuracy, with the support of more experienced team members.




Statistical Methods and Data Analysis

Knowledge of statistical methods: Familiarity with common statistical techniques like hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and basic clustering, with an eagerness to learn how to choose the right methods for different projects.
Data analysis and interpretation: Experience using statistical software or programming languages for data analysis, with guidance in generating insights and sharing findings with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Willingness to learn new methodologies: Interest in exploring and applying new statistical techniques, with support from senior team members, to solve real-world problems and stay updated on emerging theories.




Communication

Stakeholder communication: Some experience working with different types of stakeholders, both technical and business-focused, with a focus on learning to manage expectations and contribute to productive discussions.
Willingness to engage in active and reactive communication: Comfortable sharing updates and responding to inquiries, with support from team members, to help maintain a collaborative working environment.
Interpretation of stakeholder needs: Ability to understand basic stakeholder requirements and help translate them into technical solutions, with guidance in bridging the gap between technical and non-technical individuals.
Presentation skills: Experience presenting data and insights, with a focus on learning how to simplify complex information for various audiences, including senior team members.




Logical and creative thinking

Problem-solving skills: Ability to apply logical thinking to break down simpler problems and contribute to generating solutions, with support from more experienced team members.
Decision-making and action-taking: Experience in making informed decisions and prioritising tasks, with guidance to take appropriate actions in resolving issues efficiently.
Adaptability and learning orientation: Willingness to adapt to new challenges and a strong desire to learn and improve continuously.




Job Benefits

Support in applying

If you need this job description in another format, or other support in applying, please email talent@madetech.com.

Title: Data Analyst - AI & Insight
Description:
Data Analyst – AI & Insight

Salary: £50,000 – £75,000 + benefits

Location: Central London – Hybrid, 3 days per week in the office




Please note: Unfortunately, the company is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role, either now or in the future. Applicants must have permanent/unrestricted right to work in the UK. This means we are unable to consider candidates currently working under time-limited visas, including Graduate or Youth Mobility visas, even where no immediate sponsorship is required.




Use AI to analyse faster, think deeper and turn data into commercial decisions.

A leading global luxury travel business is making a significant investment into Data & AI, building an AI-first analytics function designed to transform how data is analysed and used across the organisation.




This isn't a traditional Data Analyst role centred around maintaining dashboards and producing recurring reports. The ambition is to embed AI into the everyday analytical workflow, using it alongside SQL and strong analytical thinking to interrogate data, explore commercial problems, automate repetitive work and get to actionable insight significantly faster.




You'll work alongside the Head of Data & Analytics and experienced Senior Analysts, analysing customer, marketing, sales and booking data and helping teams across the organisation make better, data-led decisions.




The Opportunity

Join a growing Data & Analytics function at a point of significant investment into AI and the underlying data infrastructure.
Use AI/LLMs alongside SQL to interrogate data, accelerate analysis and solve commercial problems.
Analyse customer, marketing, sales and booking data across a global consumer business.
Tackle open-ended questions where there isn't already a dashboard, report or obvious answer.
Use AI to help generate and interrogate code, explore hypotheses, automate repetitive analysis and validate outputs.
Turn complex analysis into clear commercial recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Work closely with experienced Senior Analysts and the Head of Data & Analytics.
Help shape how AI is embedded into the analytical workflow as the function develops.




Responsibilities

Analyse large and varied datasets to identify trends, opportunities and drivers of business performance.
Use SQL to query and interrogate data across customer, marketing, sales and booking datasets.
Use AI tools to accelerate data exploration, SQL/Python generation, debugging, analysis and validation.
Break down ambiguous commercial questions, form hypotheses and determine the appropriate analytical approach.
Conduct analysis across areas including customer behaviour, acquisition, conversion, segmentation, retention and commercial performance.
Validate AI-generated code and analytical outputs to ensure findings are accurate and commercially credible.
Automate repeatable analytical tasks and workflows where appropriate.
Translate detailed analysis into clear insights and recommendations that stakeholders can act upon.
Partner with teams across Marketing, Sales, Growth and the wider organisation.
Develop increasing ownership of analytical projects as your experience within the business grows.




Your Profile

2+ years' experience within Data Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Customer Analytics, Insights or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience with SQL, with the ability to understand and interrogate queries.
Genuine experience using AI within your analytical workflow, rather than solely for basic chat or Q&A.
This could include tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar to support analysis, coding, automation, debugging or validation.
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to break down an ambiguous problem and determine how data can be used to answer it.
Commercially minded – interested in understanding why something happened, what it means and what the business should do next, rather than simply reporting numbers.
Comfortable communicating analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders and translating complexity into clear recommendations.
Experience with Python would be beneficial but isn't essential.
Experience across customer, marketing, growth, ecommerce or commercial analytics would be advantageous but isn't essential.
Curious about AI and interested in developing more sophisticated ways of incorporating it into your everyday analytical work.
Comfortable working within a fast-moving environment where the Data & AI capability is continuing to evolve.




Why Join?

Join a leading global luxury travel business during a major investment into Data & AI.
Opportunity to work within an AI-first analytics function rather than a traditional reporting-led environment.
Work alongside experienced analysts and senior Data leadership while developing your own technical, AI and commercial capability.
Genuine opportunity to experiment with emerging AI tools and help shape how they're used across the Data & Analytics function.
Exposure to a broad range of customer, marketing, sales and commercial data.
Opportunity to take increasing ownership of complex analytical problems and build towards Senior Data Analyst level.
Work within a purpose-led organisation combining luxury travel with conservation and positive impact across local communities.
Hybrid working – 3 days per week in the London office.




How to apply

To apply for this outstanding opportunity, please contact Daniel Haymes at Pivotal for a confidential discussion on 07442871117 or email daniel@pivotallondon.co.uk.




Pivotal is an equal opportunities employer and we encourage applications regardless of ethnic origin, race, religious beliefs, age, disability, gender or sexual orientation, and any other protected status as required by applicable law.

Title: Senior Reporting Analyst
Description:
Why This Role Matters

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Online & Offline) strategy, to deliver trusted performance intelligence that enables better decision-making across our business. As a Senior Reporting Analyst, you will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive the adoption of data driven activity and support profitable customer and commercial growth. Working closely with business stakeholders, analytics teams and decision-makers across multiple functions, you will provide reporting, analysis and performance recommendations that influence strategic priorities and business outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to shape how data is used to unlock value, improve performance and accelerate growth in a fast-paced international retail environment, that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You’ll Be Doing


Create and maintain trusted reporting and performance dashboards that provide a clear, consistent view of customer, commercial and business performance across the organisation.
Analyse complex datasets to uncover trends, opportunities and risks, translating insight into clear recommendations that support better business decisions.
Partner with stakeholders across Group and Business Units to define, measure and align key performance indicators, ensuring performance is understood and acted upon consistently.
Drive the adoption of self-service reporting and analytics tools, enabling teams to independently access reliable insights and make data-led decisions with confidence.
Develop innovative reporting solutions using automation, AI and advanced analytics techniques to improve efficiency, scalability and the speed of insight generation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business challenges, identify information gaps and deliver reporting that supports customer and commercial growth.
Continuously enhance reporting capabilities, data quality and user experience to strengthen performance visibility and maximise business impact.


What You’ll Bring


Proven experience in data analytics, ideally within eCommerce, digital or retail environments, with a minimum of three years’ experience turning complex data into actionable business insights.
Advanced expertise in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), alongside strong SQL skills and experience developing scalable reporting solutions using Power BI, Looker and Excel.
A strong understanding of KPI governance, performance measurement frameworks and reporting standardisation within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
Commercially minded with the ability to identify trends, forecast performance and uncover opportunities that drive customer growth and business performance.
Excellent storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling insights tailored to different audiences.
Demonstrated experience influencing senior stakeholders, building strong relationships across functions and driving the adoption of data-led decision-making.
A proactive and curious mindset, with experience delivering reporting transformation, automation or analytics innovation initiatives that improve efficiency and business outcomes.


How You Will Make An Impact


Empower colleagues across the business with trusted, accessible insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making and improve understanding of performance.
Drive a culture of data-led decision-making by increasing trust in reporting, strengthening KPI alignment and helping teams focus on what matters most.
Identify emerging opportunities and risks early, enabling the business to take proactive action that improves customer, commercial and operational outcomes.
Champion innovation by identifying new ways to leverage automation, analytics and AI to improve insight generation, efficiency and scalability.
Build strong relationships across functions, bringing people together around a shared understanding of performance and creating alignment behind key business priorities.
Simplify complexity by turning data challenges into practical solutions that improve reporting quality, accelerate decision-making and enhance organisational effectiveness.
Contribute to profitable growth by ensuring customer and commercial intelligence is translated into meaningful actions that deliver measurable business value.


Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

What You’ll Get From Us


Competitive Salary and Bonus Scheme
Exclusive Discounts - Enjoy savings across our iconic brands.
Holiday entitlement
Hybrid Working Model
Refer-a-friend scheme
Learning and Development Opportunities - Grow your skills with tailored programmes.
Mental Health and Wellbeing Support
Life Assurance

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Company Overview:

Team Creation Limited is a fast-growing software development company operating across Asia and Europe. We provide services including market research, artificial intelligence solutions, cloud computing, and mobile application development for a broad range of international clients. Our focus is on delivering innovative and high-quality technology solutions while supporting the continued growth and development of our professional workforce.




Role Overview:

We are hiring a Senior Data Analyst to join our London team, working across our global product portfolio. You will partner with Product, Operations, and Commercial teams to shape decisions through rigorous analysis — from feature performance and A/B experimentation to market expansion, to user behaviour across regions.

We are looking for someone who is commercially sharp, technically strong, and can hold their own in a room of product managers and senior stakeholders.




Key Responsibilities:

Product analytics — Define metrics for new and existing features. Design and analyse A/B tests end-to-end: hypothesis, sample sizing, statistical readout, and decision recommendation. Diagnose user behaviour, identify drop-off points, and surface opportunities the product team has not yet considered.
Operational and commercial analysis — Build the analytical backbone for business reviews: revenue drivers, retention, cohort performance, LTV, segmentation. Translate dashboard observations into actionable next steps for ops and commercial leads.
New market and new product line analysis — Lead the analytics for market entries and product launches: sizing the opportunity, defining success metrics pre-launch, monitoring post-launch performance, and identifying what to scale or kill.
Deep-dive investigations — Own ambiguous business questions end-to-end. Frame the problem, design the analysis, build the models, validate assumptions, and present a clear recommendation. You are expected to drive the analysis, not wait to be told what to query.
Stakeholder influence — Communicate findings to Product, Ops, and senior leadership with clarity and conviction. Push back when the data disagrees with the prevailing view, and earn trust through rigour.




Qualifications & Skills:

5+ years of analytics experience in a consumer-facing product environment, with demonstrable impact on product and commercial outcomes.
Advanced SQL — comfortable writing performant queries against large, complex datasets; window functions, CTEs, query optimisation.
Strong Python — pandas, numpy, scipy, statsmodels (or equivalent); able to build analysis pipelines, not just notebooks.
Solid applied statistics — experimental design, hypothesis testing, sample sizing, multiple testing correction, regression, causal inference fundamentals. You know when a statistical method fits and, more importantly, when it does not.
Strong product sense — you understand how users interact with products, why features succeed or fail, and how to translate behavioural signals into product hypotheses. You think like a PM as much as an analyst.
Commercial thinking — you prioritise analysis by business impact, not data availability. You can articulate how your work moves revenue, retention, or growth.
Structured analytical thinking — you break ambiguous questions into structured problems, identify the right framework, and communicate the logic clearly. Frameworks such as AARRR, North Star, opportunity sizing, and driver trees should feel natural to you.
Exceptional communication — clear written and verbal English; able to influence non-technical audiences and challenge senior stakeholders with evidence.
Experience with at least one modern BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or Metabase).
Experience working with global or multi-region data — comfortable with timezone handling, currency normalisation, and cross-market comparisons.
Right to work in the UK.
Fluency in Mandarin or Cantonese is required in addition to English, for collaboration with regional teams.




We Offer:

Experience a dynamic and team-oriented work environment.
Opportunities for personal growth and learning.
An open, inclusive and supportive team where you will be valued, and your suggestions will be welcome.
26 days paid holiday per year, in addition to local public holidays.
Competitive salary.
Risk Benefits such as pension, Life Assurance (4x annual salary), Private Medical Insurance.
Team Building activities.
Local discounts and more...!

In this role, you'll help shape MoonPay's product and business decisions through data, combining deep analysis, experimentation, and strong stakeholder partnership to drive real impact.

You'll sit within our centralised Product Data team and work closely with Product and Engineering, owning analytics across the full product lifecycle, from defining problems and success metrics through to launching, measuring, and optimising products at scale.

Your work will directly influence product strategy, customer experience, and business health, helping teams make better, faster decisions through trusted insights and clear narratives. You'll also raise the leverage of the whole team by building reusable, AI-assisted analytics skills that let the wider org self-serve reliable answers.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning complex data into clear direction, influencing decisions, and helping shape the future of high-impact financial and crypto products.

What You Will Do



Partner with product and business teams to run rigorous analysis (root cause, opportunity sizing, funnel drop-off) and turn it into clear, prioritised recommendations, moving across problem areas as priorities shift.
Define, document, and maintain clear metric definitions and business context, so stakeholders can understand the performance of their area and AI tools can interpret our metrics correctly (e.g. Transaction Success Rate, Fraud Rate).
Set up tracking and monitoring for new launches and changes, and quantify and measure their impact on KPIs.
Build and maintain a reporting layer, with automated alerting and root cause analysis that flags when KPIs move unexpectedly and why.
Design, run, and interpret experiments, from A/B tests to quasi-experimental methods like difference-in-differences when randomisation isn't possible.
Model robust, trusted data in our dbt and BigQuery layer, safeguarding its quality through testing, documentation, and certification in collaboration with engineering.
Create reusable, AI-assisted analytics skills that scale the team's impact and help Product and Engineering self-serve.
Communicate complex concepts and findings to technical and non-technical audiences across different teams, while ensuring clarity and understanding to drive critical business decisions.





About You
Must-have experience and skills


5+ years of hands-on experience as a data analyst or data scientist, preferably in a product-focused role.
Advanced SQL and data visualisation are second nature to you.
Hands-on experience building data models in a modern cloud warehouse and transformation framework (e.g. dbt with BigQuery, Snowflake), with a strong instinct for data quality.
A solid grasp of statistics and probability, including experiment design and interpretation (A/B and quasi-experimental methods such as difference-in-differences).
A working understanding of how a payments or fintech business operates, including fraud, chargebacks, KYC/AML, and payment success rates.
Comfort using AI-assisted and LLM tools to accelerate analysis, and curiosity about building reusable skills that scale your impact.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder skills. You can distill complex findings for any audience up to C-level, and lead projects independently.





Nice-to-have Experience


Familiarity with our stack (dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Python) and AI tooling such as Claude Code.
Hands-on financial crime, payments, or fraud analytics experience.
Experience working in start-ups or scale-ups.





Bonus Points



A crypto-native perspective and experience with on-chain and blockchain data (e.g. Dune, Flipside, Chainalysis).
Experience making data self-serve for non-analysts (e.g. semantic layers, metric stores).

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
London (Hybrid) |circa £45,000 | Permanent




Our client is a global leader in shopper intelligence and personalised retail media. For nearly four decades they have helped many of the world's largest FMCG/CPG brands and retailers turn purchase data into measurable commercial growth. Operating across six major international markets and reaching hundreds of millions of shoppers, the business analyses billions of retail transactions every year, drawn from tens of thousands of connected stores. That gives it one of the richest and most complete views of real shopper behaviour anywhere in the industry - the kind of first-party purchase data most brands can only dream of.




The Role

Sitting within the analytics team, you'll turn shopper and campaign data into clear, actionable insight. Day to day that means building dashboards, running customer and shopper segmentation, and using Python to analyse behaviour and measure campaign performance for CPG/FMCG clients.

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role for a genuinely analytical person - someone who enjoys getting into large datasets and working out the outputs that drive decisions. You'll work closely with commercial, marketing and account teams, translating technical analysis into recommendations that non-technical stakeholders can act on.




Key Responsibilities:

Build and maintain dashboards that give stakeholders clear visibility of shopper and campaign performance.
Deliver customer and shopper segmentation to sharpen targeting, audience strategy and campaign effectiveness.
Use Python (and SQL) to extract, clean and analyse large transactional datasets.
Measure campaign performance and ROI, surfacing trends, patterns and commercial opportunities in the data.
Translate analysis into practical, commercial recommendations for internal teams and clients.
Partner with commercial, marketing and account teams to ensure analytics directly supports business objectives.
Help streamline and automate reporting workflows to make insight faster and more scalable.




Requirements:

Essential

Around 3 years' experience in a data or analytics role - ideally within CPG/FMCG, retail, loyalty or marketing/media analytics.
Strong Python for data analysis and automation.
Proven dashboard / BI development (Power BI, Tableau or similar).
Hands-on experience with customer or shopper segmentation.
Strong SQL and confidence working with large datasets.
A genuinely analytical mindset a curious, problem-solving person who enjoys getting into the data and working out the outputs.
Excellent communication - able to turn technical analysis into clear commercial insight for non-technical stakeholders.




Desirable

Exposure to FMCG/CPG, retail or loyalty-scheme data.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure or Databricks.
Understanding of campaign measurement and personalised media.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

YourParkingSpace joined forces with Arrive on our joint mission to make cities more livable, together. YourParkingSpace is one of the UK’s fastest-growing parking technology providers, changing the way people park. Our on-demand marketplace connects drivers to thousands of spaces, while our comprehensive suite of B2B solutions transforms parking assets into connected mobility hubs.

The role

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use data to drive growth and business impact. You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact


Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights.
Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement.
Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions.
Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs.
Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.
Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems.
Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use.
Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities.


Your background


A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.
2+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics or a similar analytics role.
Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently extract, manipulate and analyse complex datasets.
Experience using Tableau or another mainstream BI/data visualisation tool, such as Power BI, Looker, Metabase or Sisense.
Strong commercial awareness and an ability to connect analysis with meaningful business outcomes.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
A proactive approach, with the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and take ownership.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning complex business requirements into meaningful insights.


The role is based in London, UK, with a hybrid working model requiring three days per week in the office.

About Arrive

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Saturn is a returns-driven Canadian energy company focused on the efficient, responsible and innovative development of high-quality, light oil weighted assets, supported by an acquisition strategy targeting accretive and complementary opportunities. The Company’s portfolio of free-cash flowing, low-decline operated assets in Saskatchewan and Alberta provide a deep inventory of long-term economic drilling opportunities across multiple zones. With an unwavering commitment to building an entrepreneurial focused culture, Saturn’s goal is to increase per share reserves, production and cash flow at an attractive return on invested capital. We proudly integrate the protection of the environment, ethical and fair treatment of our employees and stakeholders, and strive to be at the forefront of what it means to be a good corporate citizen.

Saturn has an opportunity for a full-time Information Services (IS) Data Analyst based in Calgary, Alberta. Reporting to the Team Lead, Business Applications & Data Analytics, the Data Analyst is responsible for transforming enterprise data into meaningful insights that support operational efficiency, strategic decision-making, and business performance. This role will work closely with stakeholders across the organization to develop reporting solutions, maintain data quality, and support the ongoing growth of Saturn's analytics and data platform capabilities.

Some specific duties, and responsibilities of the Data Analyst include, but are not limited to:

Business Intelligence & Reporting


Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI and other reporting tools.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and deliver actionable insights.
Design and support self-service analytics solutions that enable business users to access trusted data.
Analyze business performance trends and identify opportunities for operational improvements.
Create and maintain reporting documentation, data dictionaries, and metric definitions.


Data Analysis & Insights


Collect, validate, and analyze data from multiple enterprise systems.
Perform ad hoc analysis to support operational, financial, land, production, and corporate initiatives.
Identify data trends, anomalies, and opportunities to improve business outcomes.
Support forecasting, planning, and performance measurement activities through analytical reporting.
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.


Data Quality & Governance


Monitor data quality and identify inconsistencies across business systems.
Assist in establishing and maintaining data governance standards and best practices.
Participate in data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance processes.
Collaborate with business teams to improve data accuracy and consistency at the source.
Support data stewardship initiatives and governance processes.


Data Platform & Integration Support


Work with internal and external partners to support data integrations and reporting environments.
Assist with the development and maintenance of data models, semantic layers, and curated datasets.
Support testing and validation activities related to data pipelines and reporting solutions.
Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of Saturn's analytics platform and reporting architecture.


Stakeholder Collaboration


Build strong relationships with business units to understand operational priorities and reporting needs.
Facilitate discussions on reporting requirements, KPI definitions, and data-related challenges.
Provide training and support to end users on reporting tools and analytics solutions.
Promote data-driven decision-making throughout the organization.


Qualifications And Competencies


Post-secondary degree in Computer Science, Information Management, Data Analytics, Business, Commerce, or a related field.
3-7 years of experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, reporting, or analytics role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into business insights.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
Experience in the upstream oil and gas industry.
Familiarity with Qbyte FM, CS Land, Metrix, OpenInvoice, Execute, and WellView.
Understanding of production, finance, land, or operations reporting.


Technical Skills Required


Advanced SQL experience.
Experience developing reports and dashboards in Power BI.
Strong understanding of relational databases and data modeling concepts.
Experience performing data validation, reconciliation, and quality analysis.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.


Preferred


Experience with Python for data analysis and automation.
Familiarity with Databricks, Azure Data Services, or cloud-based analytics platforms.
Understanding of ETL/ELT processes and data integration concepts.
Experience working with large or complex datasets.
Exposure to data governance and master data management practices.


If you are interested in joining our rapidly growing organization, please submit your cover letter and resume.

Saturn’s people drive our success. We offer an inclusive work environment where we embrace a diversity of people, thinking and ideas and a culture that supports personal and professional development. We want to thank all applicants for their interest in this role, however, only those considered for interviews will be contacted .

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Data Analyst pour rejoindre une équipe travaillant sur des projets data d'envergure à Montréal.

Analyser de grands volumes de données afin d'identifier des tendances, anomalies et opportunités.

Développer et optimiser des requêtes SQL complexes.
Travailler avec les services AWS afin d'extraire, traiter et analyser les données.
Participer à la conception et à l'évolution des processus de collecte, transformation et consommation des données.

Documenter les analyses, les processus et les indicateurs développés.
Participer à des projets d'amélioration continue et de modernisation des solutions data.
Évoluer dans un environnement Agile et collaboratif.

3 à 5+ années d'expérience en Data Analytics ou dans un rôle similaire.
Excellente maîtrise de SQL.

Expérience avec des outils de BI et de visualisation, tels que :
Power BI
Tableau
ou outils similaires.
Expérience dans l'analyse de données et la production de business insights.

Expérience avec Python est un atout.
Excellentes capacités analytiques et de résolution de problèmes.
Capacité à communiquer des résultats techniques à des interlocuteurs non techniques.
Expérience dans un environnement Agile.
Français et anglais professionnels.

Nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst, capable d'aller au-delà de la production de rapports et de transformer les données en recommandations concrètes.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Why Bison:


Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability



Bison Transport is committed to Diversity and Inclusion in the Workplace.

Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.
