Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
A career as a Senior Data Analyst in the Financial crime team at National Bank means serving as a Data and Analytics Specialist. This position allows you to have a concrete impact on decision-making and the evolution of the sector's analytical capabilities thanks to your expertise in data analysis, business intelligence and information governance. You will play a key role in transforming data into strategic information, supporting business partners in their decisions and contributing to the evolution of data solutions in a constantly changing environment.




Your job

Understand the needs of business partners and translate them into data requirements and adapted analytical solutions.
Analyze sector data, define business rules and ensure they are documented in order to support rigourous governance.
Prepare and validate reliable data for reports, dashboards, analyses and strategic initiatives.
Work with the it and data engineering teams to develop data platforms and contribute to modernisation projects, particularly on snowflake.
Diagnose data issues, identify their causes and coordinate their resolution to ensure operational continuity.
Produce value-added analyses, make recommendations based on data and communicate the results to the partners concerned.




Your team

The Vice-President, Technology and Data, more specialists work in an agile, proactive and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay on the cutting edge of technology and continuously improve processes.

Within the Financial crime and regulatory projects sector, you will be part of the FinCrim Data Warehouse team and report to the Senior Manager – it Delivery – Data and Analytics. Our team stands out for its expertise in data engineering, its culture of collaboration and its commitment to developing reliable, high-performance and scalable solutions that support the Bank's financial crime activities and regulatory initiatives. Our goal is to offer you maximum flexibility to promote your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible, adaptable schedule.

The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalised training programs, based on on on-the-job learning, help you master your profession and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Centre and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at any time.




Prerequisites

A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Analytics, Business Intelligence or a related field.
Over two years of significant experience in data analysis, business intelligence or analytics in a complex data environment.
Proficient SQL and be able to analyse complex data sets.
Python experience analyzing, profiling or automating data
Ability to transform business needs into data requirements and analytical solutions
Knowledge of modern data platforms, such as snowflake, as well as data modelling concepts, such as Data Vault or dimensional modelling.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.
Required skills: Business Acumen, Dashboard Creation, Data Cleansing, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data pipeline, Data Validator, Data Vaults, Data Visualization, Exploratory Data Analysis, Microsoft SQL Server, Python, Risk Data and Analytics, Snowflake, Teamwork

Your benefits
In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment
We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

Join us!

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

At Roofr, building a powerful user experience starts with data. As a Senior Data Analyst at an early-stage, high-growth company, you’ll play a critical role in turning raw data into insights that shape product decisions, drive strategy, and improve the customer experience. You’ll have a direct impact on how we use data to grow, and help influence the roadmap for how analytics evolves at Roofr.

This role sits at the intersection of data analytics and business, ideal for someone comfortable moving between modeling data, building dashboards, and advising senior leadership on growth opportunities.

What You'll Get to Do:


Partner directly with business and product owners to shape roadmaps, prioritize features, and measure success
Build an AI-first business intelligence platform to supercharge self-serve analysis
Deliver actionable insights on user behavior, market trends, and business performance to marketing, revenue and product teams.
Lead sales and marketing analytics by defining KPIs and optimizing our acquisition funnels.
Tell compelling data stories to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences
Transform, clean, and model raw data using DBT to create reliable, analytics-ready datasets
Take ownership of our analytics foundation, inheriting existing models (DBT) and data warehouse structure (Snowflake) to clean, improve, and scale them alongside a Senior Analytics Engineer.


What You'll Bring to the Role:


7+ years of experience in data analysis and/or data science, ideally on sales, marketing, and growth analytics at a SaaS company
Expertise hacking AI/ML and automation tools for growth purposes, on top of using Claude, Cortex and other AI tools to streamline analytics workflow
Proficient in BI tools like Metabase, Sigma, Tableau, Omni, or Looker
Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, PostgreSQL)
Hands-on experience with DBT for managing the Transform layer of ELT pipelines
Ability to work cross-functionally to define metrics, create dashboards, and ensure data quality
A strong analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail and accuracy


Who You Are:


Loves transforming messy data into clean models and insights
Thrives at bringing structure to chaos and able to find focus while juggling multiple projects
Lead with intent and proactively bring ideas to our partners and stakeholders
Eager to elevate your team and organization to new heights
A strong communicator with great presentation skills
Analytical with a demonstrated ability to utilize data to make informed decisions
A critical thinker who doesn’t settle for the status quo


Compensation Band: $130,000.00 - $140,000.00 CAD

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:


1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
Flexible time off
80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
RRSP/401k match
Generous Parental Leave policy


🤝 Perks:


We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
Home office setup stipend
Internet and phone allowance
Remote first culture
Weekly Friday paydays!


🤖 AI Notice

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️

⚠️ Important Notice

We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.

To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: https://roofr.com/careers.

If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at talent@roofr.com.

Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance!

Roofr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in the workplace regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Ethics and Compliance
Description:
When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.

Why join us?

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

Bombardier’s Benefits Program

With our employees’ well-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:


Insurance plans (Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)
Competitive base salary
Retirement savings plan
Employee Assistance Program
Tele Health Program



What are your contributions to the team?


Develop dashboards and reporting solutions that provide clear visibility into Ethics & Compliance metrics, trends, and risks (e.g., investigations, hotline, third-party risk, training).
Integrate and analyze data across multiple Ethics & Compliance datasets, creating a unified view to support decision-making and oversight.
Perform in-depth data analysis to identify anomalies, patterns, and potential indicators of misconduct or non-compliance.
Design and optimize data pipelines, data models, and automation processes to improve scalability, timeliness, and reliability of compliance data.
Partner with cross-functional teams (including Legal, HR, Audit, Risk, IT) to understand data needs and deliver actionable insights.
Enable data-driven investigations by extracting, analyzing, and interpreting relevant data.
Lead the evolution of analytics for our Ethics and Compliance organization, including the development of predictive analytics and forward-looking risk indicators.
Support the Strategy & Governance analyst to translate complex data into clear, business-friendly insights for leadership and stakeholders.



How to thrive in this role?


You have a Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Statistics, or a related field.
You have 5–8+ years of experience in data analytics.
You have advanced technical skills in:
SQL and data querying
Data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
You have familiarity with Databricks and programming languages such as Python or R; this would be considered an asset.
You have experience working with multiple, complex datasets and integrating them into cohesive reporting solutions.
You have an analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and hidden risks.
You demonstrate a high level of integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information.
You are curious and adaptable, with an interest in advancing into predictive and advanced analytics.
You have the ability to build dashboards and tell a compelling data story to both technical and non-technical audiences.
You have experience working within an Ethics & Compliance, Risk, Audit, or Legal environment, as well as familiarity with compliance-related frameworks and data (e.g., hotline reports, investigations, risk management, policy adherence); this would be considered an asset.



Now that you can see yourself in this role, apply and join the Bombardier Team!

Please note: You don’t need all the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.

Bombardier is an equal opportunity employer and encourages persons of any race, religion, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, immigration status, disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics to apply.

Title: Analyste Power BI F/H
HTML:
Groupe international d’ingénierie, fortil repose sur un modèle indépendant et rassemble plus de 2 500 collaborateurs. Avec 30 agences réparties dans 14 pays, fortil cultive la liberté d'entreprendre et la libération des potentiels.

Contexte

Dans le cadre du soutien aux activités de gestion de projets majeurs et complexes, l’Analyste Power BI contribue à la collecte, au traitement et à la valorisation des données provenant de plusieurs systèmes d’information. Il accompagne les équipes dans la production d’indicateurs de performance, la reddition de comptes et l’amélioration continue des processus de gestion grâce à des solutions analytiques adaptées.

Responsabilités

  • Supporter les opérations liées à l’information de gestion, notamment en matière de reddition de comptes, de suivi de performance et d’analyse de données pour des projets majeurs et complexes;
  • Collecter, transformer et analyser des données issues de différents systèmes afin de produire des rapports de gestion, des tableaux de bord et des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI);
  • Concevoir, développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord interactifs sous Power BI permettant de faciliter la prise de décision;
  • Effectuer des analyses de données avancées via Excel et des outils spécialisés en intelligence d’affaires;
  • Assurer le suivi et l’analyse des coûts, des échéanciers et de la performance des projets;
  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes afin de comprendre leurs besoins en matière de reporting et proposer des solutions adaptées;
  • Identifier des opportunités d’amélioration des processus, des outils et des systèmes en place afin d’optimiser leur utilisation et renforcer les contrôles associés;
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques de gestion de données et des processus de reddition de comptes.

Profil recherché

  • Formation universitaire pertinente en intelligence d’affaires, analyse de données, administration, gestion de projets, informatique ou domaine connexe (Diplôme d’ingénieur requis) ;
  • 10 ans d’expérience dans un rôle d’analyste de données, analyste BI ou analyste en gestion de projets;
  • Solide expérience dans la création de rapports, l’analyse de données et la production de tableaux de bord décisionnels;
  • Bonne maîtrise de Power BI (modélisation de données, création de rapports, visualisations et exploitation des données);
  • Très bonne connaissance d’Excel et de la suite Microsoft Office;
  • Connaissance des principes de contrôle de coûts et de suivi budgétaire;
  • Expérience dans des environnements de gestion de projets majeurs et complexes;
  • Capacité à analyser des données complexes, synthétiser l’information et présenter des recommandations claires aux parties prenantes;
  • Autonomie, rigueur, esprit analytique et bonnes habiletés de communication.

Les raisons de nous rejoindre

Chez fortil, nous mettons en place des leviers concrets pour accompagner votre évolution et garantir un environnement de travail stimulant :

  • L’accompagnement sur la montée en compétences
  • Un écosystème pour sortir de votre zone de confort
  • La possibilité de devenir associé
  • L’engagement dans des projets associatifs
  • Une politique dédiée à la parentalité

Fortil s’engage en faveur de l’égalité des chances.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap, sans distinction de genre, d’origine ou d’orientation sexuelle.

Title: DevOps - Data Analyst
Description:
About F12: F12 was built by uniting IT consulting firms across Canada with a shared vision: to reduce risk and complexity by crafting technology platforms that empower leaders to focus and thrive. We elevate IT conversations from ingredients to outcomes, delivering fully designed solutions with no bad options. If you’re looking for the fast lane into an IT career or want to supercharge your professional development, you’ve come to the right place. At F12, you’ll collaborate with a diverse team and gain exposure to technology services across countless businesses—building a resume rich with experience and accomplishments. Our mission is to elevate our employees by building and retaining an elite team of IT professionals equipped to deliver unmatched service to Canadian business leaders. We value humble service, continuous improvement, and hard work—and we’re looking for like-minded individuals to join us.

The Position: Support the Data Operations team by developing reporting solutions, validating data quality, documenting business definitions, and maintaining governed data products. The Data Analyst acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and the DataOps team to ensure trusted, consistent, and actionable reporting.

Responsibilities

Reporting & Analytics


Build and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards and scorecards for management and executives
Perform variance analysis between actuals, forecasts, budgets, and targets
Develop and maintain KPIs, measures, and visualizations aligned to business requirements.


Data Quality & Validation


Investigate reporting discrepancies and reconcile metrics across systems.
Support resolution of data quality issues by identifying root causes and documenting findings.
Validate reporting accuracy following deployments, system changes, or business logic updates.


Business Engagement & Requirements


Translate business questions into reporting and analytics solutions.
Partner with business teams to understand operational processes, KPIs, and reporting needs.


Governance & Documentation


Maintain KPI definitions, business glossaries, and reporting documentation.
Assist in semantic model and report certification activities.
Ensure reporting assets align with established governance standards and business definitions.


Data Product & Semantic Model Support


Support development and maintenance of reusable semantic models and views.
Support users in discovering and effectively utilizing certified reports and datasets.


Continuous Improvement


Recommend improvements to reporting, data quality, and analytics processes.
Contribute to ongoing DataOps initiatives that improve efficiency, governance, and data accessibility.


Experience


1-3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related field.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for business stakeholders.
Experience working with multiple business systems and datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to translate business requirements into reporting and analytics solutions.


Requirements


Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, formulas, data analysis).
Power BI report development and dashboard design.
Ability to trace data lineage from source systems through transformations to reporting outputs.
Basic to intermediate DAX development.
Basic SQL querying and data validation.
Experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements.
Strong documentation and communication skills.
Ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications

Technical Skills


Microsoft Fabric experience (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Semantic Models, Dataflows Gen2).
Experience with HubSpot CRM.
Experience with NetSuite ERP and revenue-related datasets.
Azure DevOps or similar work management platform.
PySpark, Python, or notebook development experience.
Experience working with APIs and data integrations.
Advanced DAX development and performance optimization.
Experience supporting or developing semantic models.


Revenue Analytics & Business Performance


Experience supporting revenue operations, sales operations, or marketing analytics functions.
Understanding of recurring revenue business models.


Governance & DataOps


Experience maintaining data dictionaries, metric glossaries, or metadata repositories.
Experience supporting certification, quality assurance, or report validation processes.
Understanding of modern analytics architectures, including data warehousing, lakehouse, and medallion architecture concepts.
Working knowledge of dimensional modeling concepts including fact tables, dimensions, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.


What You Can Expect from Us: We are proud of our forward-thinking, dynamic culture that champions diversity, inclusivity, and a respectful working environment. We also want to make sure that however you get IT done in all parts of your life, we’ve got your back. Our comprehensive total rewards program includes:


Work-Life & Growth: Three weeks vacation plus extra Flex Days, leadership development opportunities, growth coaching, and reimbursements for educational advancement and certifications.
Health & Financial Well-Being: Health Spending Account or RRSP matching, extended health care, dental and vision coverage, disability and life insurance, and an employee assistance program.
Additional Perks: Tuition reimbursement, paid time off, on-site parking, high-class office amenities, and company events.


Our Equal Opportunity Commitment


F12.net practices as an equal opportunity employer in all services locations. We are committed to building and maintaining a workforce diverse in experience, skills, and knowledge. The company maintains a strict policy to ensure equal employment opportunities and do not discriminate based on any grounds and elements protected by law.
For those requiring assistance with disabilities, information relating to accommodation and accommodation measures addressed confidentially. Please notify us in advance if any accommodations required.


Please note that this position represents a true vacancy and we do not currently use artificial intelligence (AI) to at any stage of the hiring process to screen, assess or select candidates.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Poker
Description:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

Zynga Poker is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to help drive decisions that impact millions of players worldwide. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data-driven insights.

Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience


Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
Experimentation: Design statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance
Game Integrity: Enhance fraud detection and bad actor models to maintain a healthy gaming ecosystem


Join us if you love solving analytical puzzles that impact millions!

What You'll Do


Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
Analyze player behaviour to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with game design and consumer insights teams to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
Design and maintain a suite of highly visible dashboards used by game leadership and game designers to make strategic decisions for Zynga Poker
Support the economy team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
Play a leading role in the design and continuous improvement of our fraud and bad actor models
Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.
Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.
Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which aims to significantly increase each analyst’s impact through the power of LLMs
Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
Minimum of 4 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
Proficiency in Python and SQL.
Demonstrated experience in data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
Experience/ Demonstrated interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.
Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.
Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus


Bonus Points


Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminology
Familiarity with social casino economies


What We Offer You

Zynga offers a world-class benefits package that helps support and balance the needs of our teams. To find out more about our benefits, visit the Zynga Benefits site

The pay range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $96,400 and $135,000 per Year.

However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. The use of Artificial Intelligence is not being used to screen candidates. The position is for an existing vacancy.

Please note that Zynga is unable to provide visa sponsorship or assistance for this position. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring current or future employer sponsorship.

Please be aware that Zynga does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Description:
Senior Insights Analyst




About Us

At TTC, we are Enriching lives by connecting people and places.

For over 100 years, we’ve been bringing the world closer together by crafting journeys that create lasting memories, lifelong friendships and meaningful cultural connections. Across more than 70 countries and our award-winning brands, we design and deliver travel experiences that go beyond sightseeing - they change perspectives.

Behind every unforgettable journey is a passionate team making it happen. That’s where you come in.




OUR VALUES

Everything we do is guided by our five shared commitments:

Value Every Voice - We put people first.
Act with Integrity - We do what’s right.
Explore Beyond Boundaries - We’re driven by curiosity.
Own the Outcome - We take responsibility for our decisions.
Succeed Together - We’ve got each other’s backs.




Position Summary

The Senior Insights Analyst is responsible for supporting TTC's global contact centre reporting, analytics, and operational insight capabilities across sales, service, workforce, and omnichannel performance.This role combines technical expertise with business-facing analytical support, partnering closely with operational leadership and key stakeholders to deliver scalable reporting solutions, actionable insights, and data-driven decision support.

The successful candidate will possess strong experience working with Snowflake, SQL, Power BI, and large operational datasets, while demonstrating the ability to communicate meaningful business insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience supporting contact centre or customer operations environments is highly valued, along with the ability to adapt to evolving business priorities and support continuous improvement initiatives.




Key Responsibilities

Reporting & Business Insights

Analyze global contact centre performance across sales, service, customer experience, productivity, and operational KPIs.
Deliver actionable insights through dashboards, executive reporting, and performance reviews.
Support forecasting, incentive reporting, benchmarking, and strategic decision-making.
Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and key performance drivers across regions and teams.

Technical Development & Data Management

Develop and maintain SQL queries, datasets, and reporting solutions within Snowflake and Power BI.
Manage and integrate data from contact centre, CRM, workforce, and sales platforms.
Support reporting automation, dashboard modernization, and analytical initiatives.
Ensure data quality, KPI consistency, and reporting governance standards are maintained.

Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

Partner with operational, commercial, and transformation stakeholders to align reporting with business priorities.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
Present reporting outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Serve as a trusted resource for KPI definitions, reporting methodology, and operational analytics.

Process Improvement & Transformation

Drive improvements in reporting efficiency, automation, and operational visibility.
Support transformation initiatives, including CCaaS, AI, and reporting modernization programs.
Expand customer-centric and omnichannel analytics capabilities.
Contribute to scalable reporting governance, best practices, and future-state analytics architecture.




About You

Essential Skills

3–5 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, or contact centre analytics environments.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, and Power BI.
Experience developing dashboards, reporting solutions, and business intelligence datasets.
Strong understanding of operational KPIs, reporting frameworks, and performance measurement.
Ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable business insights.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
Experience working with CRM, contact centre, workforce management, or sales platforms.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable skills

Experience working within contact centre, customer operations, or sales environments.
Experience with Genesys, Salesforce, or similar customer engagement platforms.
Experience supporting reporting modernization, automation, or transformation initiatives.
Exposure to omnichannel reporting, customer journey analytics, or AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
Experience working within global or multi-regional organizations.

Title: ICQA Data Analyst
Description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, you will be required to work autonomously, taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities


Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional work experience, or experience in MS Office, with an emphasis on Excel
Experience writing complex Excel VBA macros
Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.

Title: Analyste BI senior(e)
Description:
Aperçu

Joignez-vous à l'équipe des systèmes d'affaires et contribuez à transformer des données de projet complexes en informations claires et utiles. À titre d'analyste BI principal, vous collaborerez avec les équipes de projet, les parties prenantes d'affaires et les spécialistes technologiques afin de développer et d'améliorer des solutions d'intelligence d'affaires pour le secteur Grands projets.

Il n'est pas nécessaire de maîtriser toutes les technologies mentionnées ci-dessous. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne possédant de bonnes bases en BI, de solides capacités d'analyse et le désir d'apprendre et d'évoluer avec l'équipe.

Votre rôle


Collaborer avec les parties prenantes afin de comprendre leurs besoins et de les traduire en solutions BI concrètes.
Concevoir des modèles de données, des rapports et des tableaux de bord qui transforment les données brutes en informations pertinentes.
Développer et optimiser des requêtes SQL, des processus de transformation de données et des solutions de production de rapports.
Contribuer au développement, à l'amélioration et à la maintenance des solutions Power BI.
Soutenir la qualité, l'intégrité et la fiabilité des données utilisées pour les rapports et les analyses.
Participer aux essais et au déploiement des solutions, du développement jusqu'à la production.
Collaborer avec les développeurs, les analystes d'affaires, les chargés de projet et les responsables d'affaires.
Recommander des améliorations concrètes aux tableaux de bord, aux méthodes de production de rapports et aux pratiques de BI existantes.
Contribuer, lorsque pertinent, à l'automatisation des processus d'affaires et de production de rapports récurrents.


À propos de vous


Baccalauréat en informatique, en ingénierie, en technologies de l'information ou dans une discipline connexe, ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience pertinente.
Expérience pratique en développement de solutions d'intelligence d'affaires, de production de rapports ou d'analyse de données.
Expérience avec Power BI, notamment la modélisation de données, Power Query et DAX.
Les expériences suivantes faciliteront la réussite dans le poste, mais les candidatures présentant une expérience comparable ou transférable sont également encouragées:
Expérience en conception, en développement ou en maintenance de rapports BI, de modèles de données ou de solutions d'entreposage de données.
Familiarité avec les processus ETL ou d'intégration de données.
Expérience avec des données provenant de plusieurs sources, par exemple des bases de données, des fichiers, des feuilles de calcul, SharePoint, des applications d'entreprise ou des plateformes infonuagiques.
Expérience en soutien de solutions, du développement jusqu'à la production.
Compréhension des pratiques de qualité, de gouvernance, de sécurité et de gestion des accès'aux données.
Capacité à communiquer en français et en anglais lorsque le poste exige de soutenir des parties prenantes dans les deux langues. Le besoin d'affaires précis lié à l'anglais devrait être validé et indiqué dans l'affichage, le cas échéant.*
Une expérience avec un ou plusieurs des éléments suivants constitue un atout; la maîtrise de l'ensemble de cette liste n'est pas attendue:


Microsoft Power Automate pour l'automatisation de flux de travail ou de processus d'affaires.
API REST et services Web, notamment l'authentification, JSON, les points de terminaison, la pagination et la gestion des erreurs.
Python pour la préparation des données, l'automatisation ou l'analytique.
Flux de données Power BI.
Microsoft SQL Server.
Services Microsoft Azure tels qu'Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage ou Azure Functions.
Microsoft Fabric ou Databricks.
SharePoint et intégration d'applications d'entreprise.
Autres plateformes infonuagiques de données et d'analytique.
Conception d'entrepôts de données ou méthodes avancées d'intégration de données.
Connaissance pratique de SQL et des bases de données relationnelles.
Capacité à comprendre les besoins d'affaires et à les traduire en solutions techniques ou analytiques claires.
Solides capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et d'organisation.
Capacité à communiquer efficacement et à collaborer avec des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
Capacité à travailler de façon autonome tout en contribuant au travail d'équipe.
Curiosité et volonté d'apprendre de nouveaux outils et domaines d'affaires.
Approche collaborative et souci du service à la clientèle.
Capacité à expliquer clairement des sujets techniques.
Bon jugement et souci du détail.
Approche pragmatique et orientée vers les solutions.
Intérêt pour l'amélioration continue et le partage des connaissances.
Ce poste requiert la connaissance d'une autre langue que le français, soit l'anglais, puisque vous serez membre d'une équipe de direction canadienne, mondiale ou régional


Rémunération & avantages sociaux

Découvrez la rémunération et les avantages sociaux qui vous accompagnent à chaque étape de votre vie et de votre carrière chez AtkinsRéalis au Canada.

Bénéficiez d'une rémunération concurrentielle, d'une reconnaissance valorisante, et d'une gamme complète d'avantages flexibles, conçus pour s'adapter à vos besoins en matière de santé, de bien-être, de finances et de style de vie.

Développez votre potentiel grâce à une vaste sélection de formations et de programmes de perfectionnement professionnel, qui vous permettent d'enrichir vos compétences et d'élargir votre expertise.

Profitez également de notre culture de travail hybride, de politiques de congés généreuses, et d'un environnement qui favorise l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle.

Obtenez votre reconnaissance. En savoir plus.

Nous sommes AtkinsRéalis, une organisation de calibre mondial de services d'ingénierie et d'énergie nucléaire. Nous lions individus, données et technologie pour transformer les infrastructures et les systèmes énergétiques du monde.

Avec nos partenaires de l'industrie et nos clients, et notre équipe mondiale de consultants, ingénieurs et gestionnaires de projets, nous pouvons changer le monde. Nous nous engageons à guider nos clients à travers nos différents marchés finaux pour façonner un meilleur avenir pour notre planète et ceux qui l'habitent.

En savoir plus.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst, Analytics & Reporting

Gestion Zagora | Montréal, QC | On-site | Full-time




The opportunity

Gestion Zagora manages more than 8,000 residential units across Canada and the US. The Data Strategy & Innovation team partners with Finance, Asset Management, Operations, Accounting, and Leasing to replace manual reporting with automated, verified numbers. You report directly to the Head of Data Strategy & Innovation and you'll be the person leadership comes to when they need to know what the data actually says.




What you'll actually do

Data validation. Verify that what's in our warehouse matches reality. Rent rolls, unit counts, lease terms, collections, vacancy. You'll build reconciliation checks, chase down variances with the operating teams, and document what you find. This is a large share of the job and it is the foundation everything else rests on.

ERP migration support. You'll validate migrated data set against set, investigate mismatches, and sign off on what's clean. This is the fastest way anyone has ever learned how a property management business works.

Reporting. Help the production of recurring KPI reporting: weekly and monthly packages for leadership, bilingual French and English, built on SQL against BigQuery rather than copy-paste. Where a report is still manual, your job is to make it not be.

Analytics. Answer real questions from senior leadership. Why is turnover up in one portfolio, what does our collections curve look like by region, which buildings are underperforming their market rent and by how much. You'll define the metric, pull the data, and present the answer.

Data modelling input. Help translate operational questions into structures that scale, so the same question next quarter takes ten minutes instead of two days.




What we're looking for

Strong SQL. Joins, aggregations, window functions, and the habit of validating your own output before anyone else sees it
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets. Pivot tables, lookups, and the judgment to know when a spreadsheet is the wrong tool
Comfort with large, messy, inconsistent datasets and the patience to reconcile them line by line
Clear written and spoken French and English. Our reports, stakeholders, and source data are all bilingual
Ability to explain a number to leadership and defend how you got it
Bonus: Python and pandas, BigQuery, Power BI, Apps Script, real estate or property management data, accounting or finance coursework, ERP exposure of any kind

Background in finance, accounting, economics, engineering, or anything quantitative works.




The right mindset

You are bothered when two reports disagree, and you don't stop until you know which one is wrong
Naturally curious. You dig into problems rather than waiting for direction
Structured and independent. Small team, no micromanagement
You want to grow toward senior analyst or analytics engineering, and you're happy to pick up Python and warehouse modelling along the way




How you'll grow

We have a defined career ladder for this team. This role is the first rung on the analytics track, with a path toward owning a reporting domain and eventually the business-facing side of the department. We run bi-weekly internal technical sessions, and our head of department is a former quantitative developer who trains actively.

Title: Data Analyst / Data Scientist
Description:
Tu veux exploiter la donnée pour répondre aux vraies questions de Communauto : où sont les frictions opérationnelles, quels leviers actionner et que révèle le comportement de nos membres? Ici, l'analyse ne s'arrête pas au chiffre livré : on cherche quelqu'un qui remet en question les demandes, creuse au-delà de la demande initiale et livre une véritable analyse.




Chez Communauto, nous cherchons une personne curieuse et rigoureuse, qui aime aller chercher les réponses elle-même dans la donnée et accorde autant d'importance à la fiabilité de ses analyses qu'à la clarté avec laquelle elle les communique, au sein d'une équipe Data & AI collaborative et accessible.




Ici, la donnée n'est pas un simple rapport à produire : c'est un levier direct de décision.




Ton rôle au quotidien

Au jour le jour, tu exploiteras notre plateforme analytique interne pour répondre aux questions des équipes métier. Tu concevras des analyses ad hoc et récurrentes, tu définiras les indicateurs clés avec les équipes business, et tu collaboreras étroitement avec le ou la Data Engineer et l'équipe Data & AI pour faire évoluer la plateforme elle-même.

Ton rôle combine analyse, esprit critique et vulgarisation, avec une forte autonomie dans la façon d'aller chercher tes réponses dans la donnée.




Ce que tu feras concrètement :

Répondre aux questions métier en allant chercher directement dans la donnée.
Concevoir des analyses ad hoc et récurrentes pour éclairer les décisions des équipes business.
Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés en collaboration avec les équipes métier.
Construire des explorations, vues et rapports sur la plateforme analytique interne.
Participer à la conception et à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme, aux côtés de l'équipe Data & AI.
Poser un diagnostic clair sur les enjeux de données manquantes ou de qualité insuffisante.
Vulgariser les résultats auprès de publics non techniques.




Ce qu'on recherche

SQL avancé, permettant une autonomie complète pour explorer, croiser et interroger les données.
Python pour l'analyse (manipulation de données, statistiques, visualisation).
Bases solides en statistiques : tests d'hypothèses, corrélation vs causalité, distributions.
Très bonne compréhension de :
Modèles de données et entrepôts de données (faits, dimensions).
Environnements d'analyse modernes (plateforme analytique interne, SQL, notebooks).
Atout : notions de modélisation statistique ou de machine learning appliqué.
Atout : notions de pipelines de données, pour dialoguer efficacement avec le Data Engineer.
Atout : expérience en secteur mobilité, transport ou opérations complexes.




Ce qui fera la différence dans ce rôle

Ton esprit critique et analytique très poussé.
Ta capacité à challenger une demande métier et à creuser au-delà de la question posée.
Ton autonomie et ta rigueur.
Ta curiosité et ton aisance à évoluer avec des publics non techniques.
Ton talent pour raconter une histoire claire avec la donnée.




Pourquoi choisir Communauto ?

Tu rejoindras une équipe dynamique et bienveillante, dans un environnement reconnu pour son excellent climat de travail. L'ambiance est agréable, la collaboration est au cœur de nos pratiques, et tu seras entouré.e de collègues qui aiment ce qu'ils font.

Salaire annuel compétitif selon l'expérience.
Poste à temps plein, horaire de jour.
Semaine de 4 jours après la période de probation.
Environnement hybride (télétravail et bureau à Montréal – Centre-ville, 2 jours/semaine minimum).
Environnement de travail collaboratif et multidisciplinaire.
Interaction fréquente avec le ou la Data Engineer, les équipes métier et l'équipe Data & AI.
Outils modernes : plateforme analytique interne, SQL, notebooks Python, entrepôt BigQuery.

Description:
Data Analyst – Portfolio Performance & Optimization

EV Charging & Energy Infrastructure

Location: Toronto, ON — On-site

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Department: Product Innovation

Reports To: Director of Product & Innovation

Position Type: Individual Contributor

About ECAMION / Jule

eCAMION Inc., operating under the Jule brand, is a Toronto-based clean-technology company developing, deploying, and operating electric vehicle fast charging and energy storage infrastructure.

We design and manufacture our own charging and battery systems, develop the software that manages them, and operate our own charging network. Our work spans hardware, firmware, cloud software, site deployment, and long-term asset operations.

This integrated business creates an opportunity to connect technical performance with financial outcomes—and use those insights to improve the profitability of individual sites and the overall portfolio.

Learn more: www.julepower.com

Position Overview

We are seeking a Data Analyst – Portfolio Performance & Optimization to evaluate and improve the operational and financial performance of Jule’s EV charging network.

You will use programming, financial analysis, and forecasting to turn raw data into reliable insights at the charger, site, and portfolio levels. You will investigate differences between forecast and actual performance, identify underlying causes, and help implement solutions that improve profitability.

A central responsibility is to develop, prototype, and refine workflows for routine performance and profitability reviews. Once these workflows are validated and sufficiently mature, you will automate them directly or coordinate their handoff to the teams responsible for ongoing operation and software implementation.

Working closely with Product Innovation, Finance, Network Operations, and Software Engineering, you will follow the full improvement cycle: measure performance, investigate gaps, implement changes, and verify results.

Key Responsibilities2. Programming, Data Preparation & Forecasting3. Performance Gap & Root-Cause Analysis4. Workflow Development, Prototyping & Automation5. Solution Development & Implementation


Portfolio Performance & Profitability Analysis
Conduct routine charger-, site-, and portfolio-level performance reviews, including monthly profit-and-loss analysis and comparisons against forecasts, budgets, and prior periods.
Develop and maintain consistent performance metrics covering utilization, availability, charging activity, energy sales, revenue, operating costs, and site contribution margins.
Evaluate the drivers of site profitability, including customer demand, pricing, electricity costs, demand charges, equipment performance, maintenance, and site-related expenses.
Work with Finance to reconcile operational and financial information, validate cost assumptions, and apply consistent allocation methods across the portfolio.
Use SQL and Python to extract, clean, validate, and combine raw charging, diagnostic, energy, payment, and financial data into structured inputs for reports and models.
Develop reusable scripts and analytical tools that reduce manual work and improve the consistency, accuracy, and traceability of recurring analysis.
Build and maintain models to forecast charging demand, energy sales, revenue, operating costs, and profitability, incorporating site characteristics and clearly documented assumptions.
Use visualizations, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis to illustrate expected outcomes, key uncertainties, and the financial implications of potential decisions.
Evaluate forecast accuracy against actual results and improve models as new data and operating experience become available.
Identify material differences between forecast and actual results, quantify their financial impact, and prioritize issues for investigation.
Distinguish data-quality problems and incorrect modeling assumptions from genuine changes in customer demand, equipment performance, operating conditions, or costs.
Develop and test hypotheses using detailed records, comparisons across sites and periods, and input from engineering, finance, and operations.
Validate likely causes with the relevant teams, clearly distinguishing confirmed findings from unresolved hypotheses or information gaps.
Design and prototype repeatable workflows for routine profitability checks, performance reviews, exception reporting, and follow-up analysis.
Define the data inputs, calculation methods, validation checks, reporting frequency, exception thresholds, and follow-up responsibilities required for each workflow.
Pilot workflows with intended users, gather feedback, and refine them for accuracy, reliability, usability, and efficiency before wider adoption.
Automate validated workflows using scripts and scheduled processes where appropriate, and collaborate with Software Engineering when production-system integration is required.
Prepare mature workflows for handoff through documented logic, test cases, operating instructions, exception-handling procedures, and clearly agreed ownership.
Monitor workflow performance after implementation and address changing business requirements, data sources, or recurring failures.
Propose practical solutions to identified performance gaps, supported by an assessment of expected financial benefit, implementation effort, risks, and dependencies.
Implement improvements within the role’s scope, including revised analytical models, reporting processes, automated checks, decision-support tools, and operating review procedures.
Coordinate approved cross-functional improvements with the responsible teams, such as changes to pricing, operating practices, maintenance priorities, or software functionality.
Track actions through completion, measure results against the original baseline, and determine whether the underlying performance gap has been resolved.
Communicate findings and recommendations through clear dashboards, reports, and presentations that explain what changed, why it matters, what action is recommended, and whether the action worked.


Scope & Collaboration

This role owns the analytical process and the development of performance-monitoring workflows. It is also expected to drive approved improvements through implementation, rather than ending its involvement at the recommendation stage.

Finance retains responsibility for accounting policies and financial reporting approval. Network Operations and Engineering retain responsibility for operational interventions, equipment changes, and production-system releases. The analyst works with these teams to ensure that improvements are implemented appropriately and their impact is measured.

Qualifications

Required


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Industrial/Financial Engineering, Engineering Science, Business Analytics, Computational Finance, or a related quantitative field.
3+ years of relevant experience in data analysis, operational analytics, business intelligence, financial analytics, or a related role.
Strong SQL skills, including joining multiple data sources, time-based analysis, aggregation, and investigating incomplete or inconsistent records.
Hands-on Python skills for data preparation, analysis, modeling, visualization, and workflow automation, using libraries such as pandas and NumPy.
Demonstrated experience developing a repeatable analytical or reporting workflow, improving it through practical use, and automating it or transferring it to an ongoing owner.
Working knowledge of profit-and-loss analysis, revenue and cost drivers, contribution margins, and forecast-versus-actual variance analysis.
Experience building and evaluating forecasts or scenario models, with an understanding of seasonality, uncertainty, and forecast error.
Strong investigative skills, including the ability to test competing explanations for performance gaps and avoid treating correlation alone as proof of causation.
Experience contributing to the implementation of a business, analytical, or operational improvement and assessing its results.
Strong Excel skills and experience presenting findings through Power BI, Tableau, Python-based visualizations, or comparable tools.
Good documentation, version-control, and testing practices for analytical code and recurring workflows.
Ability to communicate clearly, coordinate cross-functional work, and follow through on unresolved issues.
Legal entitlement to work in Canada.


Preferred


Experience analysing EV charging, energy storage, electricity consumption, connected equipment, or multi-site infrastructure operations.
Familiarity with electricity tariffs, demand charges, energy losses, asset availability, or site-level operating economics.
Experience reconciling operational data with payment records, utility bills, or financial reporting systems.
Experience with time-series forecasting or machine learning, including model validation and comparison against simpler baseline methods. Familiarity with TensorFlow or similar frameworks is an asset.
Familiarity with AWS-based data environments, scheduled data-processing jobs, or integration with production reporting systems.
Experience supporting site investment assessments, deployment forecasts, or portfolio-level financial models.


What Success Looks Like

Success means Jule has a reliable, repeatable process for understanding and improving portfolio profitability. Reports require less manual preparation, material performance gaps are identified and explained sooner, forecasts become better grounded in operating evidence, and approved improvements produce measurable results.

Mature workflows are documented, automated where appropriate, and handed over with clear ownership—allowing this role to continue addressing new performance challenges rather than becoming permanently occupied with manual reporting.

What You Will Gain


Hands-on experience connecting EV charging and energy storage performance with site and portfolio economics.
Opportunities to develop practical skills in forecasting, financial analysis, workflow automation, and operational improvement.
Direct exposure to decisions across product, finance, software, and network operations.
Professional growth toward broader responsibilities in portfolio analytics, asset performance, or operational optimization.


Pay Transparency & Hiring Process

This position is being posted to fill an existing vacancy.

We are a fair, equitable, and inclusive employer committed to transparent and human-centered hiring practices. As part of this commitment, we do not use artificial intelligence or automated systems to screen applications. Every résumé is reviewed by a member of our hiring team to help reduce bias and ensure candidates are assessed fairly and thoughtfully.

All candidates who participate in an interview will be informed of the hiring decision in accordance with applicable Ontario employment requirements.

The expected salary range for this position is $75,000 to $95,000 per year, with final compensation determined based on skills, qualifications, education, technical capabilities, and relevant experience. We are committed to pay equity and to offering compensation that is fair, transparent, and competitive.


Comprehensive health and dental benefits.
Paid time off.
On-site parking.
Professional growth and development opportunities.


Jule is committed to an inclusive, accessible hiring process in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and AODA. Accommodations are available at any stage of the selection process upon request.

How To Apply

Please submit your résumé and a brief cover letter describing your relevant experience. Highlight an example where you used programming to develop or automate a workflow, investigated a performance gap, and helped implement an improvement. Describe your personal contribution and the resulting outcome.

eCAMION is committed to an inclusive and accessible hiring process. Accommodations are available at any stage of the selection process upon request.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Strong experience in data validation, reconciliation, and data quality analysis.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.

Financial services or other regulated industry experience.

Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note: this is a regular full-time (hybrid) role. Qualified applicants must be available to work in the Vancouver studio 3x per week. Canadian work authorization is required.

Data Analyst - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with production and product management partners to drive data-informed decisions within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data investigator, visualizer, and designer, helping to enhance the core experiences of our global player base.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modelling to evaluate feature design opportunities, assess risks, and support strategic investment decisions in UT.
Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets.
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners.
Explore user behavioral patterns to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies.
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making.


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making.
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis.
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a plus.

Join Our Team as a Business Intelligence Analyst - Finance & Operations at Johnson Electric!

As our next Business Intelligence Analyst, Finance & Operations will serve as the primary Power BI specialist supporting our Canadian operations and shared services functions. This role combines data analytics, reporting development, systems integration, and business partnership to improve decision-making across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and Leadership.

You will work with data from multiple ERP and business systems to develop scalable reporting solutions, improve data quality, automate manual processes, and transform complex information into meaningful, actionable business insights. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically strong Business Intelligence professional who is passionate about analytics, automation, and continuous improvement.




Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Employee Well-being: Focus on employee health and well-being through various wellness programs and initiatives.
Inclusive Workplace: Join an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees are valued and respected.
Technological Leadership: Be part of a company that drives technological advancement and continuous innovation.
High-Impact Opportunity: Help shape the digital future of a growing manufacturing organization while gaining visibility with senior leadership.
Innovation and Growth: Explore new opportunities involving AI, automation, advanced analytics, and digital reporting solutions.




What You’ll Be Doing:

Serve as the primary Power BI subject matter expert for Canadian operations and shared services.
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, data models, KPI scorecards, and executive-level performance reporting tools.
Develop and maintain data models, relationships, measures, and calculations using DAX and Power Query best practices.
Enhance existing reporting solutions and identify opportunities to improve reporting effectiveness, accessibility, and user experience.
Create automated reporting solutions that reduce manual effort and improve the availability of business information.
Monitor and optimize dashboard performance, data refreshes, and reporting processes.
Maintain reporting documentation, report inventories, and user guides.
Identify opportunities to digitalize and automate manual business and reporting processes.
Use Power BI, SQL, Power Query, Power Automate, and other analytics tools to improve business visibility and operational efficiency.

Support adoption of reporting solutions through training, documentation, and ongoing user support.
Improve data integrity across ERP, reporting, and business systems through validation, standardization, and process improvements.
Maintain data mappings, reporting structures, and master-data relationships used within Power BI environments.
Partner with Finance, Operations, and IT to establish consistent KPI definitions, business rules, and reporting standards.
Help ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and transparency across multiple plants and business functions.
Support the development and maintenance of reporting governance practices and documentation.
Support monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting requirements through automated reporting solutions and data analytics.
Work with business unit controllers, operations leaders, and management teams to understand reporting needs and business challenges.
Assist with the analysis of business performance, sales trends, operational metrics, and financial results.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning through reporting and analytical tools.
Translate complex business and technical data into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.
Respond to ad hoc reporting and analytical requests from stakeholders.




What We Are Looking For:

Experience: Three to five years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Reporting Systems, or a related field.
Education: Degree or diploma in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Finance, or a related discipline.
Power BI Expertise: Advanced Power BI capabilities, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard development, and performance optimization.
SQL Skills: Strong SQL skills with the ability to develop and troubleshoot complex queries.
Systems Integration: Experience integrating, transforming, and validating data from multiple business systems.
Microsoft Excel: Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
ERP Experience: Experience with Oracle, CMS, or comparable enterprise platforms is preferred.
Manufacturing Experience: Previous experience in a manufacturing environment is considered an asset.
Additional Technology Experience: Experience with Power Automate, Microsoft Fabric, Cognos, Python, or other analytical programming tools is considered an asset.
Emerging Analytics Tools: Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics tools, Copilot, machine learning concepts, or predictive analytics is considered an asset.
Analytical Strength: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to transform data into actionable business insights.
Communication: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Business Partnership: Demonstrated success translating business requirements into practical reporting and analytical solutions.
Accuracy: Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity.
Independence: Self-starter who can independently manage multiple priorities and projects.
Continuous Improvement: Passion for analytics, automation, technology, and process improvement.
Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while consistently delivering high-quality results




What We Offer:

Johnson Electric offers talented people like you the opportunity to grow professionally and personally, surrounded by some of the most dedicated, innovative, and entrepreneurial colleagues you will find anywhere. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Lookout, Inc. is the leader in mobile AI security, delivering continuous threat exposure management for the modern, mobile-driven enterprise. Built on over 15 years of specialized expertise and informed by a global dataset analyzing hundreds of millions of mobile devices and applications, Lookout protects organizations against both behavioral and structural mobile risk.

Through its unified platform, featuring AI Visibility & Governance and the Mobile Software Exposure Center (MSEC), Lookout secures both sides of the mobile AI equation: governing user-to-AI interactions to prevent outbound data leakage while illuminating the mobile software supply chain to neutralize inbound, machine-speed vulnerabilities. By seamlessly feeding real-time mobile telemetry into broader enterprise CTEM and SOC workflows, Lookout closes the mobile exposure blind spot, enabling organizations to reduce risk and operate with confidence. To learn more, visit www.lookout.com and follow Lookout on LinkedIn and X.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead the company's reporting and analytics function. As the sole Data Analyst, this role serves as an internal analytics consultant, partnering with teams across the organization to turn business, product, and security data into actionable insights.

The Senior Data Analyst analyzes business operations, customer behavior, mobile application telemetry, and security event data to support decision-making, measure product performance, identify trends, and inform strategic planning. They also contribute to financial reporting, assisting with quarter-end close, invoicing and reconciliation. Success in this role requires advanced SQL skills, strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, independence, and excellent communication skills.

What You'll Do

Business, Product & Security Analytics


Develop and maintain executive dashboards and operational reports using Tableau.
Analyze and contextualize:
business metrics including revenue, customer growth, subscriptions, retention, product adoption, and operational performance.
mobile application telemetry, customer behavior, product usage, and feature adoption.
security event data to monitor threats, trends, anomalies, and product effectiveness.


Partner with Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and Security Intelligence to address recurring and ad hoc analytical needs.
Define and monitor KPIs and identify trends and opportunities for business and product improvement.
Translate complex data findings into clear insights and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.



Data & Reporting


Write efficient SQL queries in AWS Athena to extract and analyze large datasets stored in Amazon S3.
Integrate data from multiple internal systems to develop meaningful reporting and analytical solutions.
Design, develop, publish, and maintain Tableau dashboards used throughout the organization.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
Document data sources, business rules, report definitions, and analytical methodologies.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and analysis.




Qualifications
