Description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

The ALTO project is a major infrastructure initiative in Canadian history, aimed at developing over 1,000 km of new passenger rail service between major urban centers, including Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal and Quebec City.

Missions/Main Duties


Manage, structure, analyze, and standardize project data to support business and user requirements.
Develop and automate data processes and optimize tools across the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem to improve efficiency and data quality.
Build and maintain dashboards, visualizations, dataflows, and semantic models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to monitor performance and generate insights.
Work with stakeholders to define reporting needs, deliver effective solutions, and support informed decision-making.
Maintain documentation and ensure compliance with governance, security, and regulatory requirements.


Profile/Skills

Education: Bachelor’s degree in in computer science, business intelligence, data analytics, statistics, business administration, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Years of experience: 2 to 3 years of experience in a similar role.

Technical Skills


Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Dataflow Gen2, Data Factory, and Notebooks, for data ingestion, storage, organization, transformation, and orchestration of analytics workflows.
Proficiency in Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to design, maintain, and optimize semantic models, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
Strong command of DAX and Power Query for data modeling, extraction, cleansing, transformation, and advanced analytics.
Solid understanding of data modeling, data governance, and data quality principles.
Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing, in French and English*
Reasons for the bilingual requirement: You will have the opportunity to collaborate with various project stakeholders; bilingualism is essential for building strong relationships with our clients, understanding their specific needs, and communicating effectively in their preferred language.


Interpersonal Skills


Analytical mindset, rigor, and autonomy
Ability to work in an agile and collaborative environment
Strong technical communication skills.

You will play a key role in transforming data into strategic information, supporting business partners in their decisions and contributing to the evolution of data solutions in a constantly changing environment.




Your job

Understand the needs of business partners and translate them into data requirements and adapted analytical solutions.
Analyze sector data, define business rules and ensure they are documented in order to support rigourous governance.
Prepare and validate reliable data for reports, dashboards, analyses and strategic initiatives.
Work with the it and data engineering teams to develop data platforms and contribute to modernisation projects, particularly on snowflake.
Diagnose data issues, identify their causes and coordinate their resolution to ensure operational continuity.
Produce value-added analyses, make recommendations based on data and communicate the results to the partners concerned.




Your team

The Vice-President, Technology and Data, more specialists work in an agile, proactive and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay on the cutting edge of technology and continuously improve processes.

Within the Financial crime and regulatory projects sector, you will be part of the FinCrim Data Warehouse team and report to the Senior Manager – it Delivery – Data and Analytics. Our team stands out for its expertise in data engineering, its culture of collaboration and its commitment to developing reliable, high-performance and scalable solutions that support the Bank's financial crime activities and regulatory initiatives. Our goal is to offer you maximum flexibility to promote your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible, adaptable schedule.

The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalised training programs, based on on on-the-job learning, help you master your profession and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Centre and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at any time.




Prerequisites

A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Analytics, Business Intelligence or a related field.
Over two years of significant experience in data analysis, business intelligence or analytics in a complex data environment.
Proficient SQL and be able to analyse complex data sets.
Python experience analyzing, profiling or automating data
Ability to transform business needs into data requirements and analytical solutions
Knowledge of modern data platforms, such as snowflake, as well as data modelling concepts, such as Data Vault or dimensional modelling.

Languages: French, English

Required skills: Business Acumen, Dashboard Creation, Data Cleansing, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data pipeline, Data Validator, Data Vaults, Data Visualization, Exploratory Data Analysis, Microsoft SQL Server, Python, Risk Data and Analytics, Snowflake, Teamwork

Your benefits
In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

Title: Sr. BI and Insight Analyst

What You'll Do

As a Senior Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming data into actionable business insights. You will work across the full analytics lifecycle, partnering with business stakeholders to design, develop, and deliver scalable analytics and reporting solutions that support data-driven decision making across marketing, loyalty, merchandising, and promotional initiatives.

In This Role, You Will


Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytical requirements, translating business questions into scalable data and visualization solutions.
Identify, source, and integrate data from multiple enterprise systems to support business intelligence and analytical initiatives.
Design, develop, and maintain automated data pipelines and curated analytical datasets using SQL, Python/PySpark, and cloud-based analytics platforms.
Leverage modern analytics technologies such as Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and Power BI to build efficient, scalable, and maintainable reporting solutions.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Auth0)
Description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Data Enablement Team

Auth0 is an easy-to-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers.  We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier 0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.

Within the Data organization, the Data Enablement team is chartered with creating scalable semantic models that make it safe for anyone to see and understand data. By partnering with product and engineering leaders, this team owns the data lifecycle from strategy to prototyping to implementation, executive dashboard and product level self-service support.

The Senior Data Analyst Opportunity

Reporting to the Manager, Data Enablement - this role will be responsible for unlocking analytics across the company. You will do this through a combination of data lifecycle ownership, data tooling enablement and outreach programs designed to foster the safe usage of scalable data models for reporting and analytic consumption.

You'll serve as a critical data and technical partner that empowers our Sales, TAM, and Customer Success teams with the deep product insights they need to succeed. An average week will find you partnering with these teams to understand their measurement needs, reviewing engineering plans to ensure we capture critical data signals from the Auth0 product and developing data products that drive key success metrics. You will have multiple tools and teams at your disposal to achieve the core outcome of creating product and customer insights that help our partners drive value and long-term customer success.

What you’ll be doing 

Partner with peers and leaders in Sales, TAM, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Program Management to develop scalable measurement strategies for our data assets, products and services
Drive scalable, semantic data models that can support stakeholders both inside of Auth0 and across the enterprise
Educate and enlighten data stakeholders with newly available objects and models that will unlock product, revenue, sales and business insights
Build reusable data models that support key concepts of the business (Entitlement, Activation, Utilization, Engagement, etc.)
Deliver executive dashboards and product insights based on foundational productionalized data models
Partner with other analysts to create composite measures and insights that span Auth0 and the enterprise
Ensure that data privacy and governance is a first priority at all stages of the data lifecycle

 

What you’ll bring to the role

5+ years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or analytics engineering, or product management
5+ years of hands-on experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Streamlit, PowerBI, Sigma, Omni, etc.)
5+ years of SQL experience
Strong understanding of data lifecycle management including instrumentation, governance, modeling and self-service interfaces
Experience working within a Jira/Agile environment to manage and prioritize technical work.
Build relationships with partners and stakeholders to understand product data needs, distill business requirements into technical documentation and prioritize work accordingly
Excellent business acumen and emotional intelligence in ambiguous environments
BA or higher, preferred; additional relevant work experience in lieu of a degree is acceptable

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!    

Cloud based data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, etc.)
Data engineering (Python, dbt, Kafka, Parquet, DuckDB, etc.)
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and the Pull Request process.
Proficiency with advanced data skills/code, such as working with Claude code or other LLM-based data analysis tools.
Paywall, subscription or authentication based products

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

At Roofr, building a powerful user experience starts with data. As a Senior Data Analyst at an early-stage, high-growth company, you’ll play a critical role in turning raw data into insights that shape product decisions, drive strategy, and improve the customer experience. You’ll have a direct impact on how we use data to grow, and help influence the roadmap for how analytics evolves at Roofr.

This role sits at the intersection of data analytics and business, ideal for someone comfortable moving between modeling data, building dashboards, and advising senior leadership on growth opportunities.

What You'll Get to Do:


Partner directly with business and product owners to shape roadmaps, prioritize features, and measure success
Build an AI-first business intelligence platform to supercharge self-serve analysis
Deliver actionable insights on user behavior, market trends, and business performance to marketing, revenue and product teams.
Lead sales and marketing analytics by defining KPIs and optimizing our acquisition funnels.
Tell compelling data stories to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences
Transform, clean, and model raw data using DBT to create reliable, analytics-ready datasets
Take ownership of our analytics foundation, inheriting existing models (DBT) and data warehouse structure (Snowflake) to clean, improve, and scale them alongside a Senior Analytics Engineer.


What You'll Bring to the Role:


7+ years of experience in data analysis and/or data science, ideally on sales, marketing, and growth analytics at a SaaS company
Expertise hacking AI/ML and automation tools for growth purposes, on top of using Claude, Cortex and other AI tools to streamline analytics workflow
Proficient in BI tools like Metabase, Sigma, Tableau, Omni, or Looker
Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, PostgreSQL)
Hands-on experience with DBT for managing the Transform layer of ELT pipelines
Ability to work cross-functionally to define metrics, create dashboards, and ensure data quality
A strong analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail and accuracy


Who You Are:


Loves transforming messy data into clean models and insights
Thrives at bringing structure to chaos and able to find focus while juggling multiple projects
Lead with intent and proactively bring ideas to our partners and stakeholders
Eager to elevate your team and organization to new heights
A strong communicator with great presentation skills
Analytical with a demonstrated ability to utilize data to make informed decisions
A critical thinker who doesn’t settle for the status quo


Compensation Band: $130,000.00 - $140,000.00 CAD

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:


1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
Flexible time off
80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
RRSP/401k match
Generous Parental Leave policy


🤝 Perks:


We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
Home office setup stipend
Internet and phone allowance
Remote first culture
Weekly Friday paydays!


🤖 AI Notice

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️

⚠️ Important Notice

We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.

To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: https://roofr.com/careers.

If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at talent@roofr.com.

Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance!

Title: Data Analyst / Data Scientist
Description:
Tu veux exploiter la donnée pour répondre aux vraies questions de Communauto : où sont les frictions opérationnelles, quels leviers actionner et que révèle le comportement de nos membres? Ici, l'analyse ne s'arrête pas au chiffre livré : on cherche quelqu'un qui remet en question les demandes, creuse au-delà de la demande initiale et livre une véritable analyse.




Chez Communauto, nous cherchons une personne curieuse et rigoureuse, qui aime aller chercher les réponses elle-même dans la donnée et accorde autant d'importance à la fiabilité de ses analyses qu'à la clarté avec laquelle elle les communique, au sein d'une équipe Data & AI collaborative et accessible.




Ici, la donnée n'est pas un simple rapport à produire : c'est un levier direct de décision.




Ton rôle au quotidien

Au jour le jour, tu exploiteras notre plateforme analytique interne pour répondre aux questions des équipes métier. Tu concevras des analyses ad hoc et récurrentes, tu définiras les indicateurs clés avec les équipes business, et tu collaboreras étroitement avec le ou la Data Engineer et l'équipe Data & AI pour faire évoluer la plateforme elle-même.

Ton rôle combine analyse, esprit critique et vulgarisation, avec une forte autonomie dans la façon d'aller chercher tes réponses dans la donnée.




Ce que tu feras concrètement :

Répondre aux questions métier en allant chercher directement dans la donnée.
Concevoir des analyses ad hoc et récurrentes pour éclairer les décisions des équipes business.
Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés en collaboration avec les équipes métier.
Construire des explorations, vues et rapports sur la plateforme analytique interne.
Participer à la conception et à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme, aux côtés de l'équipe Data & AI.
Poser un diagnostic clair sur les enjeux de données manquantes ou de qualité insuffisante.
Vulgariser les résultats auprès de publics non techniques.




Ce qu'on recherche

SQL avancé, permettant une autonomie complète pour explorer, croiser et interroger les données.
Python pour l'analyse (manipulation de données, statistiques, visualisation).
Bases solides en statistiques : tests d'hypothèses, corrélation vs causalité, distributions.
Très bonne compréhension de :
Modèles de données et entrepôts de données (faits, dimensions).
Environnements d'analyse modernes (plateforme analytique interne, SQL, notebooks).
Atout : notions de modélisation statistique ou de machine learning appliqué.
Atout : notions de pipelines de données, pour dialoguer efficacement avec le Data Engineer.
Atout : expérience en secteur mobilité, transport ou opérations complexes.




Ce qui fera la différence dans ce rôle

Ton esprit critique et analytique très poussé.
Ta capacité à challenger une demande métier et à creuser au-delà de la question posée.
Ton autonomie et ta rigueur.
Ta curiosité et ton aisance à évoluer avec des publics non techniques.
Ton talent pour raconter une histoire claire avec la donnée.




Pourquoi choisir Communauto ?

Tu rejoindras une équipe dynamique et bienveillante, dans un environnement reconnu pour son excellent climat de travail. L'ambiance est agréable, la collaboration est au cœur de nos pratiques, et tu seras entouré.e de collègues qui aiment ce qu'ils font.

Salaire annuel compétitif selon l'expérience.
Poste à temps plein, horaire de jour.
Semaine de 4 jours après la période de probation.
Environnement hybride (télétravail et bureau à Montréal – Centre-ville, 2 jours/semaine minimum).
Environnement de travail collaboratif et multidisciplinaire.
Interaction fréquente avec le ou la Data Engineer, les équipes métier et l'équipe Data & AI.
Outils modernes : plateforme analytique interne, SQL, notebooks Python, entrepôt BigQuery.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada's top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Solutions team. In this role, you'll help build integrated, reliable, and scalable data solutions that support business decision-making across the organization. Working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Greenhouse, and Dayforce, you'll collaborate with business and technology partners to analyze data, support system integrations, improve data quality, and contribute to impactful enterprise-wide data initiatives. If you're curious, analytical, and enjoy working at the intersection of business, data, and technology, this could be an exciting next step in your career. Our offices operate on a hybrid model with three days per week in-office to support team collaboration.

What You Will Do


Analyze and profile data across enterprise systems to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Support the design and development of scalable data models and data structures for reporting, analytics, and integrations.
Collaborate with data engineers and application teams to define and validate data transformation rules.
Test and validate REST APIs, integrations, and data flows between business applications and data platforms.
Perform data quality, reconciliation, and validation activities to ensure accuracy and completeness of information.
Develop and execute test cases for data mappings, APIs, and end-to-end integration processes.
Document data models, mappings, integration requirements, and technical processes.
Participate in Agile delivery activities, including testing, defect resolution, and release validation.
Help identify opportunities to improve data usability, consistency, and operational efficiency across the organization.


What You Bring


3-5 years of experience in data analysis, business systems analysis, data integration, or a related technology role.
Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing relational data.
Experience working with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Dayforce, Greenhouse, or similar CRM, ATS, HRIS, or SaaS platforms.
Knowledge of relational data modelling concepts and data integration principles.
Experience working with and testing REST APIs, including JSON and API testing tools such as Postman.
Strong experience in data validation, reconciliation, and data quality analysis.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to document requirements, data mappings, testing activities, and technical processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and software development lifecycles.
Experience with Power BI or other reporting and analytics platforms.
Experience with Python or another scripting language.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern data technologies.
Experience working with HR, recruiting, CRM, finance, or other enterprise business data.
Financial services or other regulated industry experience.


The starting salary for this position is $110,000 - $130,000. The starting salary provided reflects the base salary for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation of this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment and selection process. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact talentacquisition@cclgroup.com if you require accommodation.

AI may be used to support certain stages of our screening & recruitment process. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment and decision-making.

We’re looking for a detailed-orientated individual to join our growing analytics team as an iLottery Digital Gaming Analyst to work remotely within Canada in the Central or Eastern time zone. This is an exciting opportunity that performs analysis and projections related to iLottery digital gaming to influence the success of the organization’s new and current iLottery portfolio. Reporting to the Manager of Digital Analytics, this role will plan, organize, and follow through on requirements related to game launches and player behavior within iLottery products.

Who We Are

With a legacy spanning over a century, Pollard Banknote has become a world leader in instant ticket manufacturing and digital lottery solutions that enhance player engagement through cutting-edge technology. Our diverse and talented team brings ideas to life through creativity, innovation, and collaboration. From exciting lottery experiences to impactful partnerships, we’re shaping the future of gaming and making a difference in millions of lives. Join us and help reimagine how the world plays.

What We Offer


Competitive compensation
Profit sharing program – every role plays a part in our success!
Comprehensive Group Benefits
Opportunities for professional development
A variety of committee-driven employee engagement activities
Remote Work Environment


What You'll Do


Ensure on time delivery of regular reporting and actionable eInstant Game Studio insights to internal and external stakeholders to inform strategic business decisions
Assist in eInstant Benchmark reporting design and development
Maintain and analyze iLottery annual and monthly goals model
Assist with iLottery new business analysis by request
Monitor and collaborate on insights from iLottery industry with internal stakeholders
Assist and support the Manager of Digital Analytics as needed
Miscellaneous tasks as requested by Director of Digital Games Studio


Who You Are


A highly motivated self-starter with superb verbal and written communication skills
A creative go-getter who dives in, takes the initiative and sees projects through to completion
An analytical thinker who collects and analyzes data & insights to make sound decisions
A team player with the ability to build and maintain relationships at all levels of the organization
A detail-oriented professional with the ability to prioritize tasks and remain organized in a fast-paced environment


What You'll Bring


3+ years working in the analytics industry
Post-Secondary education in a field with an emphasis on statistical and analytical skills such as statistics, mathematics or computer science
Superior written and verbal communication skills
Proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite; Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint
Experience and/or a keen interest in technology, digital applications and websites
Experience building analytical models
Hands-on experience supporting data driven insights for new business initiatives
Experience using analytical platforms such as Quicksight, or Microsoft Power BI


Pollard Banknote Limited is an equal opportunity employer, committed to promoting and maintaining a diverse and inclusive workforce. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Autodesk Education
Description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100787

Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

Reporting to the Head of Lead Management, this role will be responsible for delivering insights that optimize sales performance, improve customer retention, and support new market expansion initiatives through the transfer of operational knowledge and best practices. The successful candidate will leverage analytics, automation solutions to improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experience.




Key Responsibilities




1. Sales Optimization & Growth Support (30%)

Analyze sales performance and identify opportunities to improve lead conversion, agent productivity, and overall sales effectiveness
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting for key sales metrics
Support forecasting, capacity planning, and sales strategy initiatives
Provide actionable insights to support the continued growth of the sales organization
Identify opportunities to automate reporting and business process




2. Care & Support Analytics (Post-Sales & Retention) (50%)

Analyze customer and policyholder behavior to identify drivers of retention, persistency, and customer satisfaction.
Monitor and report on key post-sales metrics, including retention, service levels, and customer experience.
Partner with Care & Support teams to identify operational improvement opportunities.
Support the development and measurement of customer retention initiatives.
Deliver insights that improve customer lifetime value and operational effectiveness.




3. New Market Expansion & Knowledge Transfer (20%)

Support the organization's expansion into new markets by documenting and transferring key operational, sales, lead management, and customer service learnings from existing business operations.
Partner with stakeholders to capture best practices, processes, reporting frameworks, and performance insights that can be leveraged in future markets.
Develop and maintain knowledge repositories, documentation, and reporting standards to support successful market launches.
Identify opportunities to replicate successful sales, lead management, and customer retention strategies across markets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure operational readiness and consistency during market expansion initiatives.
Track and report on key readiness milestones and business learnings throughout implementation programs.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Economics, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related role.
Experience in Life Insurance, Financial Services, or a regulated industry is preferred.




Technical Skills

Strong SQL skills, including Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL).
Experience using Python for data analysis, reporting, and automation.
Proficiency with Power BI and/or Tableau.
Experience with Databricks and modern analytics tools.
Working knowledge of AI/Machine Learning concepts and predictive analytics.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

At Sonatype, we empower developers with best in class tools to build secure, high-quality software at scale. Our mission is to create a world where software is always secure and developers can innovate without fear. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we are pioneers in software supply chain management, open source security, and DevSecOps.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team. In this role, you will transform complex product datasets into actionable insights, build scalable analytics infrastructure, mentor associate-level analysts, and drive data-informed product decisions.

What You’ll Do


Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.
Analytics & Data Modeling: Own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data modeling, dashboard creation, and KPI development. Deliver high-accuracy analyses independently across various product initiatives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, managing requirements and delivering precise insights on tight turnarounds.
Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.


What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

2025 Best DevSecOps Solution by DevOps Dozen

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
Your Moneris Career - The Opportunity

We are looking for a Business Data Analyst to join our analytics team and help deliver data-driven insights across product performance, customer onboarding, operational efficiency, and business reporting.

In this role, you will work with large datasets, build and maintain reports and dashboards, analyze business trends, and provide leadership teams with accurate, actionable insights. You will partner with stakeholders across Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to measure performance, identify opportunities, and support informed decision-making.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving business problems through data, improving reporting processes, and translating complex information into clear recommendations. The successful candidate will contribute to reliable reporting, stronger business insights, and increased visibility into product and operational performance.

Location: You will be based in our Etobicoke office, balancing in-office collaboration with remote flexibility.

Reporting Relationship: You will report to the Manager, Analytics – Product & Operations.

Posting Type: Replacement.

Salary Range: The expected base salary range for this role is $71,000 - $100,000.

Total compensation may also include variable or discretionary incentive components, including but not limited to bonuses and commissions. Individual job offers are determined by various factors, including experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Your Moneris Career - What You'll Do


Build, maintain, and enhance recurring reports, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical outputs used by business and leadership teams.
Analyze trends across product performance, customer onboarding, operational service levels, revenue, customer experience, sales channels, and business process efficiency.
Extract, validate, and analyze data from multiple systems using SQL, Excel, BI tools, and other analytics platforms.
Translate business questions into clear analysis, insights, and recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support recurring reporting cycles, leadership updates, performance reviews, and ad hoc analytical requests.
Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, establish metric definitions, validate assumptions, and ensure reporting accuracy.
Identify data quality issues, reporting gaps, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to automate and improve reporting processes.
Maintain documentation for key reports, dashboards, data sources, metrics, assumptions, and business rules.
Contribute to analytics modernization initiatives, including dashboard enhancements, reporting automation, data model improvements, and migration to modern data platforms.


Your Moneris Career - What You Bring

Required skills and experience


Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Equivalent work experience may be considered.
3–5 years of experience in a Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Operations Analyst, or similar role.
Experience building and maintaining reports, dashboards, or recurring business performance reporting.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions, data validation, and analysis of large datasets.
Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data preparation, and structured analysis.
Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Experience analyzing data from multiple sources to identify trends, issues, and business implications.


Experience That Would Set You Apart


Experience in payments, financial services, technology, product analytics, operations analytics, or customer experience analytics.
Experience with Python, Jupyter Notebook, Snowflake, dbt, reporting automation tools, or statistical analysis.


Your Moneris Career - What You Get

At Moneris, we believe in empowering you to succeed—personally and professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to resources, opportunities, and an inclusive environment that supports your development and career.


Comprehensive Total Rewards Program, including performance-based bonuses, flexible benefits starting from day one, and your choice of a health spending account (HSA) or personal spending account (PSA).
Retirement planning support, with profit-sharing programs including company match and a defined contribution pension plan.
Growth & development opportunities, including unlimited access to Coursera, mentorship programs, and an internal gig marketplace.
Holistic wellness support, with an Employee & Family Assistance Program, 24/7 virtual healthcare, and workplace wellness initiatives.
Flexibility that works for you, including hybrid work arrangements, a Work from Abroad program, and paid time off programs.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst / Senior Analytics Engineer to work a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our San Francisco or Toronto offices, and to translate complex healthcare and product data into clear, actionable insights that drive strategy and business impact. You are a fit if you thrive in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, own analytical deep work end to end, and enjoy influencing decisions through rigorous, well-communicated analysis.

What you’ll do:


Work cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success to scope and implement trusted business metrics, proactively identify data integrity issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes to inform business priorities.
Communicate analysis results and outcomes clearly and tailor messaging based on the audience.
Help build and evolve our analytical foundation, including event instrumentation, metric frameworks, and scalable self-serve analytics tools.
Mentor other analysts and raise the bar for data storytelling, analytical rigor, and stakeholder influence across the organization.


What we look for:


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
5+ years of experience building and maintaining analytics data models using tools such as dbt
5+ years of experience designing analytics architecture and data layers that support multiple business functions and reporting use cases
5+ years of experience implementing data quality checks, testing, and monitoring to ensure reliable reporting
Understanding of BI and reporting, with experience supporting tools such as Metabase, Looker, Tableau


Bonus (Nice to have):


5+ years of experience with a programming language such as Python or R.
5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques.
Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or a related field.
Experience working with sales organizations and familiarity with funnel and pipeline processes.
Strong mentorship and leadership skills, with a track record of elevating scientific standards and developing junior talent across teams.


Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:


Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
Paid parental leave.
A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.


(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

Notice to Candidates:

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page.

Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.

EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Compensation Range: $154,907 - $246,445

Title: Sr. BI and Insight Analyst
Description:
What You'll Do

As a Senior Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming data into actionable business insights. You will work across the full analytics lifecycle, partnering with business stakeholders to design, develop, and deliver scalable analytics and reporting solutions that support data-driven decision making across marketing, loyalty, merchandising, and promotional initiatives.

In This Role, You Will


Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytical requirements, translating business questions into scalable data and visualization solutions.
Identify, source, and integrate data from multiple enterprise systems to support business intelligence and analytical initiatives.
Design, develop, and maintain automated data pipelines and curated analytical datasets using SQL, Python/PySpark, and cloud-based analytics platforms.
Leverage modern analytics technologies such as Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and Power BI to build efficient, scalable, and maintainable reporting solutions.
Design and develop robust data models, semantic models, and reporting datasets that enable trusted, high-performing self-service analytics.
Apply data modeling best practices, including dimensional modeling, star schema design, fact and dimension structures, and measure governance to support enterprise reporting needs.
Build and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards, scorecards, and visualization solutions that provide meaningful insights to business users and leadership teams.
Develop advanced DAX calculations, KPIs, performance metrics, custom tooltips, drill-through experiences, and other interactive reporting features to enhance analytical capabilities.
Conduct analysis of campaign, customer, loyalty, sales, and promotional performance to identify trends, opportunities, and business drivers.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and quality by implementing validation processes, data governance standards, and reporting best practices.
Communicate complex analytical findings through clear visualizations, presentations, and business-focused storytelling.
Continuously improve reporting frameworks, data assets, and analytical processes through automation, optimization, and innovation.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
3+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, marketing analytics, performance measurement, or a related field.
Strong SQL skills with experience querying, transforming, and validating large datasets.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining Power BI solutions, including data modeling, DAX development, report design, and dashboard visualization.
Strong understanding of dimensional modeling concepts, fact and dimension tables, star schema design, and semantic model development for Power BI.
Experience developing automated data pipelines using Python, PySpark, SQL, or similar technologies.
Experience working with cloud-based analytics and data engineering platforms.
Experience with Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or similar modern analytics platforms is highly desirable.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Career growth opportunities and product discounts

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




This role follows our in‑office work model and requires employees to be onsite four days per week to support collaboration and business needs.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries




This opportunity is for an existing vacancy with the company. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $55,000 - $95,000. Exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, education, and budget. Salary range may vary based on geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a bonus program. In addition, The Company offers a variety of benefits to eligible employees, including health insurance coverage, wellness programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education-related programs, paid holidays and vacation time, and many others. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.




CI Financial is an independent company offering global wealth management and asset management advisory services through diverse financial services firms. Since 1965, we have consistently anticipated and responded to the changing needs of investors. We are driven by a commitment to provide individuals and institutions with the highest-quality investments and advice. Our commitment to the highest levels of performance means that whatever their position, CI employees must be comfortable in a fast-paced environment that will stretch them to tap into their highest potential. Employees with a healthy dose of ambition, a desire to commit to a curious mindset for continuous learning, and a willingness to go the extra mile thrive at CI.




A Supportive Environment for Success

We offer an in-office environment, competitive benefits, and a supportive workplace to help our employees thrive both personally and professionally.

Modern HQ location within walking distance from Union Station
Training Reimbursement
Paid Professional Designations
Employee Savings Plan (ESP)
Corporate Discount Program
Enhanced group benefits
Parental Leave Top–up program
Paid time off for Volunteering

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Auth0)
Description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Data Enablement Team

Auth0 is an easy-to-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers.  We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier 0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.

Within the Data organization, the Data Enablement team is chartered with creating scalable semantic models that make it safe for anyone to see and understand data. By partnering with product and engineering leaders, this team owns the data lifecycle from strategy to prototyping to implementation, executive dashboard and product level self-service support.

The Senior Data Analyst Opportunity

Reporting to the Manager, Data Enablement - this role will be responsible for unlocking analytics across the company. You will do this through a combination of data lifecycle ownership, data tooling enablement and outreach programs designed to foster the safe usage of scalable data models for reporting and analytic consumption.

You'll serve as a critical data and technical partner that empowers our Sales, TAM, and Customer Success teams with the deep product insights they need to succeed. An average week will find you partnering with these teams to understand their measurement needs, reviewing engineering plans to ensure we capture critical data signals from the Auth0 product and developing data products that drive key success metrics. You will have multiple tools and teams at your disposal to achieve the core outcome of creating product and customer insights that help our partners drive value and long-term customer success.

What you’ll be doing 

Partner with peers and leaders in Sales, TAM, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Program Management to develop scalable measurement strategies for our data assets, products and services
Drive scalable, semantic data models that can support stakeholders both inside of Auth0 and across the enterprise
Educate and enlighten data stakeholders with newly available objects and models that will unlock product, revenue, sales and business insights
Build reusable data models that support key concepts of the business (Entitlement, Activation, Utilization, Engagement, etc.)
Deliver executive dashboards and product insights based on foundational productionalized data models
Partner with other analysts to create composite measures and insights that span Auth0 and the enterprise
Ensure that data privacy and governance is a first priority at all stages of the data lifecycle

 

What you’ll bring to the role

5+ years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or analytics engineering, or product management
5+ years of hands-on experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Streamlit, PowerBI, Sigma, Omni, etc.)
5+ years of SQL experience
Strong understanding of data lifecycle management including instrumentation, governance, modeling and self-service interfaces
Experience working within a Jira/Agile environment to manage and prioritize technical work.
Build relationships with partners and stakeholders to understand product data needs, distill business requirements into technical documentation and prioritize work accordingly
Excellent business acumen and emotional intelligence in ambiguous environments
BA or higher, preferred; additional relevant work experience in lieu of a degree is acceptable

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!    

Cloud based data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, etc.)
Data engineering (Python, dbt, Kafka, Parquet, DuckDB, etc.)
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and the Pull Request process.
Proficiency with advanced data skills/code, such as working with Claude code or other LLM-based data analysis tools.
Paywall, subscription or authentication based products

Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
Experimentation: Design statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact

Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.

Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
Minimum of 4 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data

Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.
Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus

Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminology
Familiarity with social casino economies

Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

Zynga Poker is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to help drive decisions that impact millions of players worldwide. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data-driven insights.

Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience

  • Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
  • Experimentation: Design statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
  • Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance
  • Game Integrity: Enhance fraud detection and bad actor models to maintain a healthy gaming ecosystem

Join us if you love solving analytical puzzles that impact millions!

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
  • Analyze player behaviour to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with game design and consumer insights teams to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
  • Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
  • Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
  • Design and maintain a suite of highly visible dashboards used by game leadership and game designers to make strategic decisions for Zynga Poker
  • Support the economy team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
  • Play a leading role in the design and continuous improvement of our fraud and bad actor models
  • Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.

  • Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which aims to significantly increase each analyst’s impact through the power of LLMs
  • Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.

  • Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Demonstrated experience in data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
  • Experience/ Demonstrated interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
  • Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.
  • Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
  • Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.
  • Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminology
  • Familiarity with social casino economies
