Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Borrowell:

At Borrowell, we're on a mission to help Canadians feel confident about their money. We empower individuals to take control of their financial futures by providing the tools and insights needed to understand, build, and use their credit effectively.

1 in 10 Canadians use Borrowell for comprehensive credit monitoring and personalized insights. Our innovative services, including Credit Builder and rent reporting, help consumers build credit so they can unlock access to a wider range of financial products at more competitive rates. Additionally, we offer personalized financial product recommendations from Canada's most trusted providers based on each member's credit profile and financial goals.

Our team is diverse, inclusive, and driven by a shared passion for making a meaningful difference in the lives of Canadians. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of collaboration, humility, and innovation. If you're looking to join a company that's transforming the financial landscape and empowering Canadians to achieve their financial aspirations, we invite you to explore career opportunities at Borrowell. Together, we can help Canadians feel confident about money.

About this role:

As a Data Analyst you will be a key member of Borrowell's Data Analytics Team. Your role will be pivotal in informing new marketing and product initiatives and powering the recommendations we personalize to each of our 3+ million members.

You'll provide a window into business performance and help to make recommendations on what we build next. You can expect to be responsible for creating and managing insights, experimentations, forecasting, and reporting for various business partners at Borrowell. You'll monitor existing key performance indicators, explore new areas of data to drive business growth and product development, and make company data accessible, insightful and actionable to the different business divisions.

This role specifically focuses on being a data thought partner to a designated Product Manager and related cross-functional Product pod (in-house folks in engineering, devops, QA, mobile, and more).

Key Responsibilities


Data Modeling & Infrastructure: Build, maintain, and optimize data models daily using SQL and dbt to ensure a robust, high-quality data infrastructure
Reporting & Forecasting: Deliver business reporting, forecasting, and actionable insights to guide business decisions, leveraging Looker (or similar BI tools)
End-to-End Experimentation: Design, analyze, and validate statistical experiments to support product and business initiatives
Data Proficiency: Write clean, efficient SQL queries using joins, aggregates, subqueries, and window functions to query and structure complex datasets
Stakeholder Communication: Partner cross-functionally to translate complex analytics into clear, actionable business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences


Requirements

Nice to Have


Undergraduate (or higher) degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Science, Eng, or Social Sciences).
Basic knowledge of Python (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn) or R (tidyverse: dplyr, data.table, ggplot2...etc.)
Proven experience interpreting data and translating analytical results into impactful business strategies


Benefits


The Opportunity - join and have a major impact at a growing company that is helping Canadians feel confident about money
Comprehensive Health Benefits - medical, dental, vision, and paramedical health benefits for you and your family, with extra yearly coverage for psychotherapists and massage therapists
Additional Health Benefits - virtual benefit offering that allows you to connect 24/7 with nurses, doctors and mental health professionals
Maternity & Parental Leave Top-up - available to new parents
WFH Reimbursement - we ship you gear like a laptop, mouse, keyboard, and you can reimburse additional items to make your workplace better for you
Employee Development Benefit - annual reimbursements on payments to help your learning
Givewell Benefit - 1 paid volunteer day a year to give back to the community
Flexibility - flexible working hours and a flexible vacation policy


We are remote-first across Canada with an office in Toronto. This role requires you to attend in-person meetings and team-building events. While this role is remote, we are currently only able to hire candidates physically located in Ontario, BC, or Alberta.

At Borrowell, one of our core values and firm beliefs is that diversity makes us better. If you're unsure about your qualifications for this position we'd still encourage you to apply. We're looking for candidates who have experience but know that not everyone's had a chance to demonstrate what they can do. What's most important is that you have a growth mindset and care about helping people with their finances - an area in their lives that causes a lot of stress.

Please note that due to the sensitive nature of the work we do, clearing a credit and criminal record check is a condition of employment.

By submitting your application, you consent to Borrowell's use and processing of your personal information in connection with your job application at Borrowell and its recruitment processes.

Borrowell encourages applications from candidates with differing abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodation at any stage in the selection process.

This posting represents a current and active vacancy within our organization.

The budgeted annual salary range for this role is $75,000 - $125,000 CAD. Starting pay is determined by the candidate's relevant experience and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for Borrowell's full benefits package.

Our innovative services, including Credit Builder and rent reporting, help consumers build credit so they can unlock access to a wider range of financial products at more competitive rates. Additionally, we offer personalized financial product recommendations from Canada's most trusted providers based on each member's credit profile and financial goals.

Our team is diverse, inclusive, and driven by a shared passion for making a meaningful difference in the lives of Canadians. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of collaboration, humility, and innovation. If you're looking to join a company that's transforming the financial landscape and empowering Canadians to achieve their financial aspirations, we invite you to explore career opportunities at Borrowell. Together, we can help Canadians feel confident about money.

About this role:

As a Data Analyst you will be a key member of Borrowell's Data Analytics Team. Your role will be pivotal in informing new marketing and product initiatives and powering the recommendations we personalize to each of our 3+ million members.

You'll provide a window into business performance and help to make recommendations on what we build next. You can expect to be responsible for creating and managing insights, experimentations, forecasting, and reporting for various business partners at Borrowell. You'll monitor existing key performance indicators, explore new areas of data to drive business growth and product development, and make company data accessible, insightful and actionable to the different business divisions.

This role specifically focuses on being a data thought partner to a designated Product Manager and related cross-functional Product pod (in-house folks in engineering, devops, QA, mobile, and more).

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Modeling & Infrastructure: Build, maintain, and optimize data models daily using SQL and dbt to ensure a robust, high-quality data infrastructure
  • Reporting & Forecasting: Deliver business reporting, forecasting, and actionable insights to guide business decisions, leveraging Looker (or similar BI tools)
  • End-to-End Experimentation: Design, analyze, and validate statistical experiments to support product and business initiatives
  • Data Proficiency: Write clean, efficient SQL queries using joins, aggregates, subqueries, and window functions to query and structure complex datasets
  • Stakeholder Communication: Partner cross-functionally to translate complex analytics into clear, actionable business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences

Requirements

Nice to Have

  • Undergraduate (or higher) degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Science, Eng, or Social Sciences).
  • Basic knowledge of Python (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn) or R (tidyverse: dplyr, data.table, ggplot2...etc.)
  • Proven experience interpreting data and translating analytical results into impactful business strategies

Benefits

  • The Opportunity - join and have a major impact at a growing company that is helping Canadians feel confident about money
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits - medical, dental, vision, and paramedical health benefits for you and your family, with extra yearly coverage for psychotherapists and massage therapists
  • Additional Health Benefits - virtual benefit offering that allows you to connect 24/7 with nurses, doctors and mental health professionals
  • Maternity & Parental Leave Top-up - available to new parents
  • WFH Reimbursement - we ship you gear like a laptop, mouse, keyboard, and you can reimburse additional items to make your workplace better for you
  • Employee Development Benefit - annual reimbursements on payments to help your learning
  • Givewell Benefit - 1 paid volunteer day a year to give back to the community
  • Flexibility - flexible working hours and a flexible vacation policy

We are remote-first across Canada with an office in Toronto. This role requires you to attend in-person meetings and team-building events. While this role is remote, we are currently only able to hire candidates physically located in Ontario, BC, or Alberta.

At Borrowell, one of our core values and firm beliefs is that diversity makes us better. If you're unsure about your qualifications for this position we'd still encourage you to apply. We're looking for candidates who have experience but know that not everyone's had a chance to demonstrate what they can do. What's most important is that you have a growth mindset and care about helping people with their finances - an area in their lives that causes a lot of stress.

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
Responsibilities

Position Summary:

As a Business Data Analyst, you will play a key role in analyzing and interpreting data from multiple sources, leverage data driven insights and automation solutions to guide strategic business decisions, streamline data workflows, and improve operational efficiency. This role requires strong technical skills, with a focus on data automation and process optimization. The ideal candidate possesses a strong analytical mindset and a strong problem-solving abilities, and can translate complex datasets into scalable, automated solutions and actionable business recommendations.

Position Responsibilities May Include, But Not Limited To

Data Automation, Analysis & Interpretation


Extract, clean, and analyze large datasets from multiple data sources (JDE, KOMPASS, MBSYNC, Samsara, Paragon, among others) and data warehouse (Snowflake) to enable automated insights into business performance
Design and maintain automated workflows and data pipelines to reduce manual reporting and improve data accuracy. Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify patterns, trends, and relationships that inform business decisions
Assist in the design and deployment of analytics analysis to support process optimization and data insights
Perform root cause analysis of business challenges and recommend automated, data-driven solutions
Identify opportunities for process improvements, cost reductions, and efficiency gains using data and automation
Ensure data quality and accuracy through proper validation techniques, best practices and governance processes


Reporting and Visualization


Design, develop, and maintain automated reports, dashboards, and visualizations
Collaborate with department heads to define and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) relevant to the company’s strategic goals
Translate business questions into data requirements and provide concise answers through self-service reporting and automation


Alternative Solutions (Machine Learning and AI Integration)


Work with the global team to identify opportunities for alternative solutions
Assist and support in the deployment of models that support operational decision-making
Evaluate results and continuously improve automated solutions to align with business objectives
Stay updated on emerging technologies and integrate modern automation techniques into business workflows


Data Quality & Governance


Maintain data integrity, ensure consistency across automated processes. Collaborate with data ingestion and IT teams to close data gaps and improve automation readiness
Ensure compliance with data privacy and internal governance standards
Ensure data quality and accuracy through proper validation techniques, best practices and governance processes


Stakeholder Collaboration


Work closely with various business units (Operations & Transportation, Finance, Supply Chain, ROP, REX, Centralized Routing) to understand their business needs and develop tailored automation or reporting solutions. Present automated data insights and recommendations to senior leadership
Serve as a liaison between technical teams (data ingestion, engineering) and business stakeholders to align automation efforts with priorities


Project Management


Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects focused on
data automation, insight generation, and continuous improvement. Track project milestones and ensure timely delivery of automation initiatives
Other projects or duties as assigned

Required Skills and Experience:


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science or a related field. 2-4+ years of experience data automation and process optimization. Experience building Extract, Transform & Load (ETL) processes and managing data pipelines across multiple data sources and warehouses

Experience of scripting languages (like Python, R, SQL) and data process workflow automation tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data topics to non-technical stakeholders. Eagerness to explore alternative solutions that support data automation and process optimization insight delivery
Collaborative mindset with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement
This position must pass a post-offer background check

Master’s degree preferred

Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

Join the Zynga Poker Analytics Team

Zynga Poker is seeking a Principal Data Analyst to help drive decisions that impact millions of players worldwide. At Zynga, Principal is the next step above Senior; a great fit for analysts ready to take on broader ownership and scope. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data-driven insights.

Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience


Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
Experimentation: Design, conduct, and analyze statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance
Game Integrity: Enhance fraud detection and bad actor models to maintain a healthy gaming ecosystem


Join us if you love solving analytical puzzles that impact millions!

What You'll Do


Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
Analyze player behavior to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with game design and consumer insights teams to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which is doing significant strides in improving analytics workflows through AI
Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
Design and maintain a suite of highly visible dashboards used by game leadership and game designers to make strategic decisions for Zynga Poker
Support the economy team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
Play a leading role in the design and continuous improvement of our fraud and bad actor models
Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.
Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.
Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
Minimum of 8 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably with 6 years in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
Proficiency in Python and SQL.
Demonstrated experience in data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.
Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
Experience/ Demonstrated interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.
Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus


Bonus Points


Experience/ Interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminology
Familiarity with social casino economies

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Citylitics Inc.

Citylitics delivers predictive intelligence on where, how, and why infrastructure investments will occur across North America.

Infrastructure includes the foundational systems that shape our quality of life: water, transportation, transit, roads and highways, broadband, and power. It represents a multi-trillion-dollar market and a 20+ year megatrend in North America.

Citylitics transforms millions of documents across more than 40,000 cities, utilities, and public agencies into real-time market signals and high-value sales intelligence. Leading infrastructure vendors, engineering firms, and construction companies use the platform to identify and pre-position for major infrastructure opportunities earlier, helping them build relationships, shape project priorities, and influence scope before projects move to formal procurement.

Citylitics combines a network of AI agents, fine-tuned models, a proprietary infrastructure signals graph, and daily human-in-the-loop quality assurance workflows to deliver highly nuanced and reliable sales intelligence. The platform integrates seamlessly with CRMs, ERPs, and data lakes, embedding actionable insights directly into sales workflows so teams can prioritize the right pursuits and build stronger pipelines.

Our mission is to improve how infrastructure investments get made so critical needs can be addressed earlier and communities benefit from stronger, more resilient infrastructure.

Join Citylitics to work in a meaningful industry that will matter for decades to come while helping grow a company at the forefront of applied AI. We operate with a Results-Driven Mentality and a commitment to Raise The Bar, in a collaborative environment where Teamwork Makes the Dream Work as we tackle big challenges and celebrate wins together.

Who Are We Looking For?

Citylitics is looking for a Data Analyst to own our Custom Solutions practice. You'll scope and deliver client-specific data requests that don't fit our standard product.

You will partner directly with Sales, Customer Success, Product and leadership to triage incoming requests, assess feasibility before anything is promised to a client, query and validate data in BigQuery, and build the one-off dashboards or reports that answer a client's actual question.

This role fits someone analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, and disciplined about scope. You size up a vague ask fast, align stakeholders when it's over-committed, and educate clients on data availability and nuances while developing solution options to discuss with them. Once you've validated an approach with the customer, you hand the engineering work to the team. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need enough confidence in SQL and data structures to know what's realistic. You're also comfortable presenting data findings and methodology directly to clients and helping them interpret what the results mean. You move quickly and decisively, without overanalyzing.

This role is based in our downtown Toronto office and requires 3+ days in-office per week.

Vacancy Status: This position is for an existing and active vacancy that Citylitics is currently seeking to fill.

What Will You Accomplish?

Triage and Scope Custom Solution Requests

You will own the front door for custom solutions requests, deciding what's worth committing to before it reaches a client.

Responsibilities include:


Field new custom-solution requests from Sales and Customer Success as they come in (Slack, demo follow-ups, live calls)
Assess feasibility and turnaround before anything is committed to a client
Align stakeholders when a request is over-scoped or under-priced
Educate clients on data availability and nuances
Develop solution options to discuss with the client before committing to delivery


Query, Validate, and Build One-Off Deliverables

You will do the actual data work behind each request, once it's been scoped.

Responsibilities include:


Query BigQuery to test and validate client-specific hypotheses
Build or update lightweight dashboards (Looker, etc) for one-off client deliverables
Disambiguate against existing coverage to avoid duplicating work


Hand Off to Engineering Once Customer Validation Is Achieved

You validate the approach with the customer before engineering builds it.

Responsibilities include:


Write up findings and requirements clients or account teams can act on directly
Hand off anything requiring pipeline or scraper-level work to engineering, with a clear spec
Surface it immediately when a client's own criteria don't hold up
Other duties as assigned


Requirements

Must-Have Experience


2+ years of experience in data analysis, solutions consulting, business analysis, or a similar role
Strong SQL fluency (BigQuery a plus), comfortable self-serve querying
Scopes an ambiguous request before diving in and defines what "done" looks like from the start
Strong written and verbal communication for client-facing summaries
Comfortable working directly with clients or internal commercial teams under a fast turnaround pace
Comfortable presenting data findings and methodology directly to clients and helping them interpret results, not just retrieving data
Moves quickly and decisively, without overanalyzing


Nice-to-Have Experience


Enough SQL/notebook fluency to spec engineering work credibly (not to build it)
Prior consulting or client-facing analyst background
Familiarity with a BI/dashboarding tool (Looker, Tableau, etc.)


Benefits

Why Citylitics?


This is a rare opportunity to influence positive change within one of the biggest societal challenges of our generation: sustainable public infrastructure
You get to support a disruptive solution with a compelling value proposition into an industry that is eager to hear from you and in a market with no direct competition
We live at the cross section of infrastructure, scaleup and data science/AI. There is no other team like us in Toronto
There is no corporate bureaucracy here. You will accomplish more here in a few months than what you would in a few years at a large, entrenched technology company
We believe that Data and AI will play an outsized role in our future, so we equip every team member with access to Generative AI tools and our full Data Universe to enhance their productivity and encourage innovation through experimentation
We are proud to offer every CityZen in-role professional growth, skill-based development & learning, and internal promotion opportunities
We work hard, we play together, we win as a team! We are on a mission to solve infrastructure while savoring the moment and celebrating the little details along the way


Citylitics is an equal opportunity employer. We are passionate about providing a safe workplace where everyone is accepted and has the opportunity to grow with us. We are committed to making diversity and inclusivity part of our culture!

Title: Business Insights & Analytics Analyst
Description:
At OSL Retail Services, we believe people are the heart of everything we do, and it is an exciting time to be part of something special! Our momentum is growing, and is fueled by innovation, collaboration, and a shared entrepreneurial spirit that drives real results. Founded in 2012 in Mississauga, Ontario, OSL delivers customized sales solutions in retail, direct sales, and customer acquisition, all built on a foundation of integrity, respect, and passion. Our culture thrives on connection, purpose, and growth. If you’re looking for a place where your talents are valued, your ideas matter, and your career can grow, we’d love to meet you.




About The Role

We are currently seeking a Business Insights & Analytics Analyst. This role advances our analytical maturity in the fast-paced retail and direct sales industries. Going beyond standard reporting, the position focuses on uncovering what is happening, why it is happening, what is likely to happen next, and what the business should do about it. The ideal candidate is a curious, commercially minded analytical thinker who can translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations while partnering with business leaders to drive better decision-making.




What you’re responsible for:




Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, relationships, and business opportunities, going beyond standard reporting to uncover the “so what”
Translate analytical findings into clear insights, recommendations, and actions that support measurable business outcomes
Apply statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, and other advanced techniques to solve business problems
Identify opportunities to use predictive analytics and machine learning to understand drivers and anticipate future outcomes
Partner with business leaders to translate challenges into analytical questions, hypotheses, and actionable insights
Provide analytical thought partnership on strategic and operational decisions (forecasting, workforce planning, sales performance, customer behavior, and operational performance)
Leverage generative AI and AI-powered tools to accelerate data exploration, research, analysis, and insight generation
Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and other functions to understand needs and identify analytical opportunities
Develop dashboards, scorecards, and visualizations when appropriate to communicate insights and support decisions
Use tools such as SQL, Python, Domo, Power BI, Tableau, and other analytical technologies to explore, analyze, and communicate data
Partner with BI Developers and data teams to ensure analysis is based on accurate, reliable data and to translate requirements into scalable solutions




To join our team




Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Management Information Systems, or a related field
5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, financial analytics, market research, statistics, or a related analytical role (retail or data-driven environment preferred)
Strong SQL and data analysis skills, with experience applying statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, predictive analytics, or other advanced techniques
Experience with analytical and visualization tools such as Python, Domo, Power BI, Tableau, R, or similar
Familiarity with machine learning, generative AI, and AI-powered analytical tools, with interest in applying emerging technologies
Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with ambiguity and independently identify opportunities from data
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear, compelling insights for non-technical audiences




The salary for this role is $71K to $78K, with a yearly eligible 5% bonus. Your final compensation will reflect your years of experience and beyond the numbers, we’re proud to offer a holistic package that includes:

Generous time off: Start with 3 weeks of vacation.
Comprehensive benefits package: Includes medical, dental, vision and a health spending account.
Retirement support: Company-sponsored RRSP matching program to help build your financial future.
Award-winning culture: Proud to be one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies for 8 years running — now a Platinum Club member.
Invested in you: Structured employee development programs designed to help you thrive.




We’re committed to supporting your success every step of the way. What are the next steps?




The Interview Process

Step 1: If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first conversation with the recruiter.

Step 2: The next step is a virtual or in person interview with the hiring manager.

Step 3: The final step is an in-person interview with the hiring manager and extended team members.

Company Overview

At Fidelity Canada, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services - and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future. Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best - both personally and professionally.

Business Overview

Reporting to the Manager, Reporting and Analysis, the Data & Visual Insights Analyst supports the organization's reporting, analytics and business intelligence functions by gathering, organizing, analyzing and distributing insights that feed operational, financial and strategic decision-making. The role is responsible for maintaining recurring reports, designing dashboards, administering data feeds, monitoring data quality, performing foundational analyses, and assisting with reporting automation initiatives.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior analysts and business leaders, develop technical expertise in reporting, SQL, data management, visualization, and business intelligence while helping stakeholders understand business performance through accurate and timely information. They will also be detail-oriented, intellectually curious professionals with a passion for data and continuous learning.They combine strong analytical thinking, technical aptitude, and business awareness to deliver accurate reporting and actionable insights. Through reliable report delivery, strong stakeholder support, and ongoing development of SQL, reporting, visualization, and analytical skills, they build the foundation for progression into senior analytics and business intelligence roles.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Reporting & Performance Monitoring


Maintain and update daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual performance reports
Produce recurring operational, financial, and management reporting packages
Administer systematic reporting processes and ensure reports are delivered accurately and on schedule
Monitor business performance metrics and identify notable trends and exceptions
Assist with report enhancements and modifications based on stakeholder requirements
Coordinate reporting activities and support reporting schedules across business areas


Dashboard Development & Data Visualization


Create and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and visual reports that communicate business performance
Design basic visualizations using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools
Support senior analysts in dashboard development and reporting projects
Prepare presentations and reporting materials that communicate analytical findings effectively
Apply visualization best practices and standardized reporting formats


Data Quality, Governance & Data Management


Validate data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across multiple systems
Maintain critical reporting tables, data repositories, and reporting datasets
Document source tables, data definitions, business rules, and reporting processes
Identify, investigate, and escalate data quality issues and reporting discrepancies
Support data governance initiatives and maintain compliance with reporting standards
Assist with the management of internal and third-party data feeds used for reporting and analysis


Data Analysis & Insights


Gather, organize, and analyze data from multiple sources
Perform ad-hoc analyses to support business questions and decision-making
Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement
Support senior analysts in evaluating operational and financial performance
Provide meaningful business context and insights alongside analytical outputs
Assist with performance measurement and KPI reporting initiatives


Data Retrieval


Write and maintain basic queries to retrieve and validate data using the appropriate tool/scripting language for the task
Extract data for dashboards, reports, and analytical projects.
Learn relational database concepts, reporting structures, and data models.
Support reporting automation and data optimization initiatives.
Assist with maintaining reporting datasets and data warehouse structures


Reporting Automation & Process Improvement


Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting activities.
Assist with optimization of existing reports and reporting workflows.
Support efforts to improve reporting efficiency, speed, and usability.
Help eliminate redundant reports and streamline information delivery processes.
Participate in reporting enhancement and data management projects


Stakeholder Support & Training


Work closely with managers and business partners to understand reporting requirements.
Respond to data and reporting inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
Assist in educating end users on reporting tools, data sources, and analytical capabilities.
Build positive working relationships across departments.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly and effectively


The Expertise You Bring


Analytics & Problem Solving
Data Management
Business Intelligence & Reporting, visualization tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, Business Objects
Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
Communication & Professional Skills


Experience, Education


University Degree in Computer Science, Finance. Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, related analytical discipline or equivalent experience
2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, Finance Analytics or a related field
Experience working with data, spreadsheets, reports, or dashboards.
Exposure to SQL, BI tools, or reporting systems is considered an asset.
Experience analyzing data and communicating findings through reports or presentations is preferred


Nice to Have


Financial services experience considered an asset
Basic understanding of financial reporting and performance analysis
Familiarity with data warehouse concepts
CPA, or other analytical or business designations considered an asset

Nous sommes une coopérative canadienne de services financiers de premier plan engagée à promouvoir activement une société durable et résiliente, et notre équipe est essentielle au succès de cette stratégie. Administrer et assurer la maintenance de la plateforme de gestion de portefeuille de projets (PPM Pro), notamment la configuration du système, la gestion des flux de travail des utilisateurs, l’intégration des rapports ainsi que le soutien continu aux utilisateurs et à la plateforme.

Procéder à des essais approfondis et à des pratiques de rapprochement sur les données et les indicateurs
Fournir un soutien à l’équipe d’analytique d’affaires pour la distribution en matière de communication des données et des rapports, y compris les essais et suggestions d’améliorations
Produire l’information et l’analytique pour soutenir les demandes opérationnelles ponctuelles.
Effectuer des analyses descriptives et diagnostiques de manière autonome en utilisant les méthodes recommandées.

Vous possédez d’excellentes facultés de communication, de gestion du temps et de résolution de problèmes; attention aux détails.

Title: Data & Reporting Analyst
Description:
Company: CGL

Department: Strategic Execution

Employment Type: Regular Full-Time

Work Model: Hybrid (2 days in office)

Language: This role operates in English.

The Opportunity

We are a leading Canadian financial services co-operative committed to being a catalyst for a sustainable and resilient society and our team is essential to deliver on this strategy. That’s why we prioritize our people, to ensure we provide a strong culture and development opportunities which enables our team to thrive and to live our purpose. The best part is that you will work with people that care passionately about you, our clients and our communities.

As a Data & Reporting Analyst, you will play a key role in supporting project and portfolio decision-making through the development, administration, and optimization of data, reporting, and project portfolio management solutions. You will design and develop data models, reporting solutions, and interactive dashboards that effectively addresses business reporting needs to support delivering meaningful insights for strategic, financial and portfolio management and planning. We invite you to join us and help shape the future of project management within our organization!

How You Will Create Impact


Administer and maintain project portfolio management platform (PPM Pro), including system configuration, user workflow management, reporting integration, and ongoing system support.
Design and develop SQL-based data models, reporting solutions, and interactive Power BI dashboards to support business intelligence and decision-making.
Able to work closely with business and technology partners to gather and document requirements for Data, Dashboard, and reporting needs around the organization's projects and initiatives.
Autonomously manage and design reporting assets through enterprise tools (ie. Project Management tools, Excel and PowerBI) to enable easy and effective analysis and reports.
Produce data and analytics to support ad-hoc requests on strategic and operational projects and initiatives with expert knowledge to extract, clean, reconcile and prepare the data required for the analysis.
Able to autonomously perform descriptive and diagnostic analysis using recommended methods to improve information flows and views of project information with a solid understanding of project life cycles and impacts



To Join Our Team


You have 2-5 years of experience in a project reporting, planning or portfolio management.
You have an engineering mindset with a passion for puzzling information together to provide fact-based analysis.
You are an expert in Microsoft Tools (i.e. Excel and Powerpoint) and knowledgeable on analytics tools and languages (e.g. MicroStrategy, PowerBI, SQL, SAS, Python, R, etc).
You have the ability to do simple coding/programming for reporting.
Experience working with of project management and planning tools e.g. Planview, Clarity, Monday.com, Oracle, SAP etc.)is an asset.
You have a post-secondary education in Actuarial, Mathematics, Statistics, computer sciences or any other relevant field.
Strong communication, time management, problem solving and attention to detail skills.



How You Will Succeed


You influence change and are committed to continuous improvement, in order to exceed client expectations.
You leverage critical thinking skills to identify problems and proactively propose solutions.
Your strong communication skills allow you to clearly convey messages.
You’re an effective team player who shares knowledge to support our peers.



What You Need To Know


You will be subject to a Background check as a condition of employment, in the event you are the successful candidate.



What’s in it for you?


Training and development opportunities to grow your career.
Flexible work options and paid time off to support your personal and family needs.
A holistic approach to your well-being, with physical and mental health programs and a supportive workplace culture.
Paid volunteer days to give back to your community.
In addition to our competitive salary and incentive programs, eligible employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package including group retirement savings plans, pension and benefits (e.g., health and wellness, dental, disability and life coverage), mental health support and an employee assistance program.



Salary information

Expected salary range $60,574 to $100,956

The salary amount for the successful candidate is determined by Co-operators in its discretion and will vary depending on several criteria including but not limited to: local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualification, experience and education.

Employees may also have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and earn additional compensation tied to individual and/or business performance, or other business metrics.

Title: Business and Data Analyst
Description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Business & Data Analyst to support the launch and growth of our consumer lending business in Canada.

This is a key role in building our data and analytics capabilities from the ground up. The successful candidate will initially play a hands-on role in establishing our data, BI and reporting foundation, and will progressively take on broader business analytics across customer acquisition, application and conversion, product performance, operations, customer lifecycle and overall business performance.

The ideal candidate combines a strong quantitative and analytical foundation, hands-on data capabilities, and strong business sense. You should be comfortable working directly with data, building dashboards and reporting solutions from scratch, identifying the drivers behind business performance, and translating analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.

Experience in consumer lending, fintech, banking or other credit-related businesses is highly preferred.




Key Responsibilities

1. Business Intelligence & Reporting

Build and develop the company's BI and reporting capabilities from the ground up.
Develop and maintain dashboards and recurring reports covering key business and operational metrics.
Establish and maintain a consistent KPI framework and business performance reporting structure.
Extract, consolidate and transform data from multiple sources to support business reporting.
Automate recurring reporting processes and continuously improve reporting efficiency and accuracy.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate them into practical data solutions.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency and reliability of key management reports and dashboards.

2. Data Management & Analytics

Use SQL and other analytical tools to extract, clean, transform and analyze data from multiple sources.

Title: Healthcare Research & Data Analyst
Description:
Clarivate provides advisory and management consulting services to industry leading and emerging pharmaceutical, biotechnology and MedTech companies. We combine deep domain expertise and data driven analysis to deliver relevant insights and customized, actionable solutions for our clients in the areas of new product planning, commercial strategy and pricing & market access.

We are seeking a Healthcare Research & Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will support high‑impact analytical and market insights projects by interpreting complex healthcare datasets, identifying key trends, and developing actionable recommendations for clients. You will collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams, engage directly with customers, and help deliver the trusted intelligence that enables our clients to accelerate innovation and improve patient outcomes.

About You – Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments


Bachelor’s degree with a concentration in sciences, healthcare, data analytics, or business.
Minimum 3 years of experience in quantitative data analysis, ideally with exposure to healthcare datasets.
Proven experience working with complex datasets, investigate data issues, identify trends/gaps, and produce actionable insights.
Proficient in SQL, with experience querying and managing large, multi-dimensional data sources.
Strong client-facing communication skills, including presenting data insights to internal and external stakeholders.


It would be great if you also have…


Advanced degree
Experience with life sciences customers
Familiarity with additional data languages (e.g., Python, R), which would help expand analytical capabilities and improve efficiency in working with complex healthcare datasets
Exposure to or experience with project management responsibilities, including planning, coordination, and stakeholder communication across cross-functional teams


What You Will Be Doing In This Role...


Lead end-to-end market research projects delivering quantitative insights on global medical device markets, while building market models using Clarivate’s proprietary healthcare datasets.
Develop deep expertise in healthcare data and the medical industry, building strong knowledge of backend datasets, data dictionaries, and product methodology to confidently interpret, explain, and apply insights.
Engage directly with clients—from Fortune 500 companies to startups—to understand their pain points, manage calls with high-level knowledge of their product portfolios, and provide strategic solutions that address their challenges.
Deliver impactful presentations and training, using concise PowerPoint summaries to clearly communicate findings, key trends, and recommendations to both internal and external stakeholders.
Investigate complex data challenges by deep-diving into data pipelines and sample chain perspectives, proactively identifying issues, highlighting gaps/trends, and proposing actionable solutions.
Collaborate closely with Product Managers and cross-functional teams, capturing client feedback, informing statement of work documentation, and contributing to product enhancements, features, and data model evolution.


Hours of Work


This is a full-time position, working primarily core business hours EST zone
This is a hybrid position working in the office up to 3 days a week within our offices centrally located in Toronto


The expected base salary for this position is $54,400 - $68,000 CAD per year. This role is eligible for sales incentive earnings. Individual pay is based upon experience, education, skill and ability, expertise, and relevant factors. In addition to a competitive remuneration package, you will be eligible to participate in a benefits package that includes medical, dental, prescription drug, life insurance, 401k with match, long term disability coverage, vacation, sick time, volunteer time, discount programs, and many more.

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

We invite you to join us and help shape the future of project management within our organization!

Administer and maintain project portfolio management platform (PPM Pro), including system configuration, user workflow management, reporting integration, and ongoing system support.
Design and develop SQL-based data models, reporting solutions, and interactive Power BI dashboards to support business intelligence and decision-making.
Able to work closely with business and technology partners to gather and document requirements for Data, Dashboard, and reporting needs around the organization's projects and initiatives.
Autonomously manage and design reporting assets through enterprise tools (ie. Project Management tools, Excel and PowerBI) to enable easy and effective analysis and reports.
Produce data and analytics to support ad-hoc requests on strategic and operational projects and initiatives with expert knowledge to extract, clean, reconcile and prepare the data required for the analysis.
Able to autonomously perform descriptive and diagnostic analysis using recommended methods to improve information flows and views of project information with a solid understanding of project life cycles and impacts



To Join Our Team


You have 2-5 years of experience in a project reporting, planning or portfolio management.

You have the ability to do simple coding/programming for reporting.
Experience working with of project management and planning tools e.g. Planview, Clarity, Monday.com, Oracle, SAP etc.)is an asset.

Strong communication, time management, problem solving and attention to detail skills.

You influence change and are committed to continuous improvement, in order to exceed client expectations.

Your strong communication skills allow you to clearly convey messages.
You’re an effective team player who shares knowledge to support our peers.



What You Need To Know

Training and development opportunities to grow your career.
Flexible work options and paid time off to support your personal and family needs.
A holistic approach to your well-being, with physical and mental health programs and a supportive workplace culture.
Paid volunteer days to give back to your community.

Title: Business Insights Analyst
Description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:




BCU Financial is seeking a motivated and analytical full-time Business Insights Analyst to join the Product, Sales & Marketing team. Reporting to the Manager, Product, Sales & Marketing, the role supports data-driven decision-making by analyzing member, product, sales, marketing, channel, and operational data. The analyst develops reports, dashboards, and performance insights that help leadership monitor results, identify trends, and measure organizational performance. 




Working primarily with Product, Sales & Marketing and collaborating with Finance, Operations, Technology, and Member Service teams, the Business Insights Analyst transforms data into actionable business intelligence that supports planning, performance management, member growth, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate combines strong analytical capability, attention to detail, business curiosity, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:




Business Analytics & Insights

Analyze member, product, channel, marketing, sales, and operational data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities. 
Perform routine, ad hoc, and exploratory analyses in support of business initiatives and operational priorities. 
Interpret findings and develop clear, actionable recommendations for management and business partners. 
Conduct root-cause analysis to investigate performance variances, emerging issues, and business challenges. 
Prepare analytical summaries, presentations, and briefing materials for management and senior leadership. 




Business Decision Support

Provide analysis and performance information to support management decisions, operational reviews, and strategic initiatives. 
Assist with business cases, forecasting exercises, budgeting activities, and project evaluations. 
Evaluate the performance and business impact of products, services, campaigns, programs, and process enhancements. 
Participate in cross-functional projects by contributing analytical expertise, measurement frameworks, and evidence-based recommendations. 




Member & Market Analysis

Conduct member segmentation, demographic, behavioural, and lifecycle analyses to support growth and engagement strategies. 
Monitor member acquisition, retention, product adoption, channel utilization, and service usage trends. 
Analyze member behaviours and product utilization to identify opportunities to strengthen member experience and relationships. 
Research competitor activity, financial services trends, and market developments to support planning. 
Prepare comparative analyses and benchmarking reports on market position, member trends, and product performance. 




Data Management & Quality

Collaborate with Technology, Operations, Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, and other business teams to ensure the availability and reliability of data sources.
Investigate data discrepancies and recommend corrective actions to improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and consistency.
Maintain documentation of reporting methodologies, calculation logic, business definitions, and analytical processes.




Performance Reporting & Dashboard Development

Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, recurring reports, and business intelligence tools based on approved business requirements. 
Collaborate with business owners to define, track, and report on approved key performance indicators and operational metrics. 
Produce weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages for management and leadership teams. 
Monitor performance against established targets and highlight significant trends, exceptions, and areas requiring attention. 
Automate and streamline reporting processes to improve efficiency, consistency, and data accessibility. 
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of reporting outputs and underlying data sources. 




Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication

Partner with business teams to understand operational challenges, analytical needs, and reporting requirements. 
Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. 
Provide guidance to business users on interpreting reports, dashboards, performance metrics, and analytical findings. 
Assist users in understanding reporting tools and dashboard functionality. 
Encourage effective use of performance information and analytics across the organization. 




Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, automation, and predictive analytics. 
Recommend enhancements to data visualization, KPI frameworks, and analytical methodologies. 
Remain current on business intelligence tools, analytics practices, financial services trends, and industry developments. 
Contribute to initiatives that strengthen organizational reporting and analytical capabilities. 




Success Measures

Accurate and timely reports, and analytical summaries.
Clear identification of trends, exceptions, and areas requiring management attention.
Improved visibility into member, product, sales, marketing, and operational performance.
Effective support for business planning, performance monitoring, and decision-making.
Strong collaboration with stakeholders and clear communication of findings.
Continued improvement in reporting consistency, data quality, and dashboard usability.




QUALIFICATIONS:




Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 
Three or more years of experience in business analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or performance measurement. 
Experience analyzing business data and translating findings into practical recommendations. 
Experience developing reports, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI tracking tools. 
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and practical experience developing dashboards and reports in Power BI. 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, attention-to-detail, and communication skills. 
Ability to present data and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
Experience working with business systems and information sources to extract, organize, validate, and analyze data. 




Preferred Assets

Experience in financial services, banking, credit unions, insurance, or another regulated industry. 
Experience supporting product, sales, marketing, member experience, or business performance initiatives. 
Experience with member or customer analysis, market research, forecasting, trend analysis, or business case development. 
Experience with CRM systems, business intelligence platforms, or enterprise reporting solutions. 
Experience with Power Query, data modelling, or DNA’s CRM BI tool. 
Knowledge of SQL, data warehousing concepts, or statistical analysis techniques.
Experience working in member-focused, community-based, or culturally diverse organizations.




COMPENSATION:




Salary Range: $68,000 - $82,000 annually




Compensation for this role will be determined based on experience and qualifications. BCU Financial also offers a competitive and comprehensive beneﬁts package.




This role represents an existing vacancy. Interested candidates are invited to apply for this role exclusively by submitting their application via email to hr@bcuﬁnancial.com. Please note that while we thank all applicants for their interest in a career with BCU Financial, only those chosen for an interview will receive further communication.




BCU Financial Group is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. BCU Financial Group provides accommodation during the recruitment process upon request. Requests received relating to accommodation will be addressed conﬁdentially.




About BCU Financial:




BCU Financial is a member-owned ﬁnancial cooperative dedicated to improving the lives of its members and their community. As part of the growing Ontario-based BCU Financial Group, it provides Ukrainian-Canadians with diversiﬁed ﬁnancial services and products.




BCU Financial Group offers a compelling alternative to traditional banking through its various divisions. BCU Financial provides a no-fee personal chequing account, along with savings accounts, loans, mortgages, credit cards, and online banking to its members. The broader BCU Financial Group also encompasses BCU Wealth Management and BCU Insurance, serving clients with investment and insurance services respectively, and supports the community through BCU Foundation and its donors. BCU Financial, together with its BCU Wealth Management division, currently oversees $1.2 billion in assets.




Underscoring its commitment to building a strong community, BCU Financial Group provides generous sponsorship funding annually to a wide array of Ukrainian community-based projects and activities. The Credit Union and its member-supported charitable institution, BCU Foundation, provide sponsorship funding of over $1 million annually for community organizations, charity fundraisers, student scholarships, cultural events, and educational projects.

Title: Transformation Analyst
Description:
At Environmental 360 Solutions Ltd. (E360S), we don’t just manage waste - we redefine the industry. Fueled by an ambitious and innovative entrepreneurial vision and decades of leadership, we’re building a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable future. Our team is made up of driven professionals who thrive on challenge, embrace technology, and never stop learning. If you’re looking to do work that matters - where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your impact is real - you’ve come to the right place.




The Transformation Analyst provides the analytical backbone of the transformation program, delivering analytical support and dashboard development for both the broader business and the transformation initiatives themselves. This role builds interactive KPI dashboards that measure business and initiative performance, surfaces insights and flags that drive action, and applies AI and analytics tools to make reporting faster, sharper, and more predictive. The role works closely with the Transformation Finance Lead, IT, workstream leads, business stakeholders, and SMEs to ensure dashboards reflect accurate, well-governed data from approved data sources.




Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain interactive KPI dashboards tracking both business and transformation initiative performance (financial, operational, and milestone-based).
Partner with the Transformation Finance Lead, workstream leads, and business stakeholders to define KPIs, metrics, and underlying data sources across both the business and the transformation program.
Leverage AI and analytics tools to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging risks within business and program data.
Build automated flagging and alerting logic that highlights at-risk KPI and business metrics, along with a recommended call to action defined according to SME rules and logic.
Support data collection, cleansing, and integration across multiple source systems spanning business and transformation reporting needs.
Prepare analytical support and visuals for business stakeholders as well as SteerCo and Board reporting.
Prototype and pilot AI-enabled tools that support the Transformation Office's operations and broader business reporting (e.g., automated reporting, natural-language dashboard querying).
Partner with IT to ensure dashboards are built on approved, well-governed data sources.
Ensure data integrity, governance, and consistent metric definitions across all business and transformation dashboards.
Continuously refine dashboards and reporting based on stakeholder feedback and evolving business and program needs.




Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or BI development roles.
Proficiency with BI/dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and SQL.
Experience with AI/ML tools or LLM-based analytics solutions is a plus.
Prior experience in a transportation and / or environmental waste environment.
Experience building L1, L2, and L3 interactive dashboards for all levels of management and business functions




Key Skills & Competencies

Strong analytical rigor. Able to validate data quality and challenge inputs rather than building dashboards on unverified numbers.
Skilled at translating ambiguous or conflicting stakeholder requests into clear, well-defined KPIs and metric logic.
Working knowledge of AI/ML and automation tools, with the judgment to know where they add real value versus where they add complexity without benefit.
Ability to build flagging/alerting logic that produces genuinely actionable insights, not noise or false positives that erode stakeholder trust.
Strong data governance instincts, insisting on approved, well-documented data sources rather than convenient but unreliable ones.
Comfortable partnering with IT to resolve data access, integration, and quality issues
Ability to present data-driven insights persuasively to both business and transformation stakeholders, tailoring the message to the audience.
Adaptable and proactive. Able to iterate dashboards quickly based on feedback without losing consistency in underlying metric definitions.
Comfortable operating with incomplete or evolving requirements, typical of a fast-moving transformation environment.

Bring your expertise, your curiosity, and your drive. Let’s build a sustainable future we can all be proud of. Apply today and discover what’s possible when purpose meets progress.

Job Summary

Join Optimum and partner with Retention and Care Operations to transform our customer experience and help craft the next chapter of Operational Excellence. As a Staff Analyst reporting to the Director, Customer Experience Analytics, this role is pivotal in refining our approach to improve operational efficiency and reducing churn. You'll conduct robust analytics, develop insights and develop presentation and communication materials to share the findings with stakeholders.

Responsibilities


Partner with business stakeholders to clearly understand key questions and develop framework to answer the questions. This will include determining data requirements, pulling the data and analyzing large datasets to develop insights that answer key questions.

Analyze customer journeys across all interaction channels to identify patterns, friction points, and improvement opportunities.
Support A/B testing, segmentation analysis, and campaign/journey performance evaluations.
Present complex data and insights in a clear, concise manner to executive leadership, aiding in data-driven decision-making.

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Engineering)
5-7+ years of experience in analytics, insights, or data science roles. Experience in operational analytics, customer experience or a related field; telecommunications/mobile or subscription-based industry preferred
Proficiency in SQL, Google Big Query, and other analytical tools; experience with automation tools and techniques is highly desirable.
Experience with a scripting language, such as Python or R and familiarity with statistical packages
Advanced Excel skills with experience mining large data sets
Solid understanding of statistical inference, experimental design, and analytic bias
Experience with Business Intelligence reporting tools (e.g., Tableau)
Experience supporting product or business reviews such as Monthly or Quarterly Business Reviews and leadership meetings with visual or analytical support
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic team environment
Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Strong analytical and interpretive skills with a curiosity for understanding customer behavior and solution-oriented mindset able to ideate, own, and manage innovative solutions that can be leveraged by stakeholders
Ability to communicate efficiently with the ability to convey complex information to non-technical stakeholders
Strong organizational and project management skills; capability to document, prepare, and present data-driven presentations

Title: Reporting Analyst
Description:
Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Reporting Analyst is responsible preparing business reports to assist with enabling decision makers in making well-informed business decisions.

Key Duties And Responsibilities


Responsible for data integrity within information management systems.
Compiles and maintains large volume of real estate portfolio data within information management systems to support various reporting, benchmarking and analytical requirements.
Generates and compiles data from multiple data sources using various business intelligence tools and information management systems.
Prepares various reports including but not limited to performance reports and scorecard reports to assist with business communication and decision making.
Performs calculations and analysis to fulfill requirements including but not limited to performance reporting, occupancy cost allocation and chargeback, budget to spend variance reporting.
Other duties as assigned.



Knowledge And Skills


Community college diploma or equivalent training (e.g. RPA, CET).
More than one year up to three years of job-related experience.
Data Management - Ability to process large amounts of data in an organized manner. Able to leverage insights and opportunities from data and metrics to build strategies and make recommendations.
Knowledge of trends in technology relating to software applications, such as Database tools, Power BI, Access, MS office tools, Tableau, SQL, Python, and others is considered an asset.
Comfort Around Higher Management - can deal comfortably with more senior managers; can present to more senior managers without undue tension and nervousness; can determine the best way to get things done with them by talking their language and responding to their needs; can craft approaches likely to be seen as appropriate and positive.
French is considered an Asset.
Able to manage multiple projects and priorities.
Very strong attention to detail.
Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
Computer proficiency in relational databases, reporting tools, MS Office including MS Access and MS Excel, with ability to learn new information management systems quickly.
Excellent written and oral communication including ability to communicate with users with various technical backgrounds.
Technical Learning; Picks up on technical things quickly; can learn new skills and knowledge; is good at learning new industry, company, product, or technical knowledge; does well in technical courses and seminars.
Familiarity with the development lifecycle and related change management concepts.
Knowledge in CRM, D365, PowerApps, PowerAutomate is considered an asset.



This is a regular, full-time position with a salary range of $54,185 - $67,732 per annum. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role.
