Description:
Looking to join a growing financial services team? Rogers Bank, a subsidiary of Canada's leading wireless, cable and media company, is expanding and seeking passionate individuals to develop and implement innovative financial solutions and experiences. The bank offers unique cash-back benefits and financing options for Rogers purchases using cutting-edge technology. Interested? Take the next step and consider this opportunity to make a meaningful impact with Rogers Bank.

Who We Are Looking For

As a key member of the Fraud Strategy team, the Senior Fraud Analyst performs detailed trend analysis and makes business critical recommendations to enhance performance and reduce fraud loss exposure for both external and internal fraud so that the Bank operates within its risk appetite.

The role proactively evaluates program performance, with the goal of identifying and assisting in the delivery of process improvements to drive operational efficiencies, new system capabilities, and enhanced service delivery to Rogers Bank customers.

What You'll Do


Assist in the development and performance monitoring to optimize fraud prevention and detection while maintaining a balanced approach between mitigation and risk appetite
Proactively identifies trends, draws meaningful conclusions, and delivers change recommendations at a strategic and tactical level.
Develop strong knowledge of fraud delivery platforms to articulate enhancement requirements based on industry best practices and business needs, ensuring that solutions are operationally and technologically sound and can be integrated into business processes.
Leverage industry tools and provide insights to monitor and minimize fraudulent credit card transactions across the entire account life cycle, including originations, authorizations and account reissue.
Perform regular analysis of fraud losses, transaction activity, and monitor fraud-related metrics and investigate unusual trends, data discrepancies to identify key drivers, emerging risks, and opportunities for fraud prevention.
Assist with developing, analyzing, distributing fraud reporting, and translate business requirements into data solutions and provide results with meaningful and actional information
Support the development and improvement of reporting processes, including data validation, script automation, and enhancements to reporting efficiency and accuracy.
Partner with cross-functional teams, including Fraud Operations, Finance, Acquisition, Credit Risk, third-party vendors to support data and reporting needs, identify and address emerging threats and provide data-driven analytics and insights.


What You'll Bring


University or master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or related quantitative discipline
Demonstrated work experience in data analytics, business intelligence, financial services, or credit card industry. Working knowledge of TSYS TS2, CardGuard, Determinator, Broadcom/Arcot, MasterCard Connect system, and credit card
fraud detection systems is considered as asset.
Proficient in utilizing analytical tools and programming languages to perform data extraction, preparation, manipulation, analysis, and visualization, including SQL, Python, Power BI, and Excel, and understanding of relational databases
Working knowledge of developing performance dashboards, reports, and business scorecards
Proven Ability to extract and interpret data; Providing meaningful insights and actionable recommendations from data
Experience in leveraging scheduler programs to automate reporting functions and improve process efficiency
Detail oriented, analytical, organized, and self-sufficient.
Ability to adapt and reprioritize in a fast-paced, changing work environment and work on multiple complex initiatives simultaneously

We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including


Competitive salary & annual bonus

Rogers First priority in applying to internal roles of interest

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 269197

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Team

The Data team within Global Finance & Risk Technology (GFRT) provides enterprise-level analytics, data services, governance support, and operational data management for Global Finance initiatives. The team plays a critical role in supporting financial close processes, financial reporting, data migration initiatives, system implementations, and ongoing operational activities while ensuring the delivery of high-quality Financial Data Management, Data Analysis, Data Quality, and Data Governance services across the organization.

Role


We are seeking a Data Analyst to support business operations through data analysis, reporting, process improvement, system implementation, and operational support activities.
The role is responsible for delivering analytical insights, managing data migration initiatives, supporting financial and operational processes, and developing solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and control effectiveness.
Working closely with business stakeholders, operations teams, finance partners, and technology teams, the position plays a key role in maintaining data integrity, supporting system transitions, and ensuring successful business outcomes.
The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise in data engineering, programming, data analysis, data modeling, and database design with a solid understanding of finance, accounting, and operational processes.
This individual must be highly analytical, proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of working effectively with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Technology, and Vendor teams. Experience supporting system implementations, data migrations, financial reconciliations, and process automation initiatives is highly desirable.

Experimentation: Design, conduct, and analyze statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact

Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data

Experience/ Interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.

Familiarity with social casino economies

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Citylitics Inc.

Citylitics delivers predictive intelligence on where, how, and why infrastructure investments will occur across North America.

Infrastructure includes the foundational systems that shape our quality of life: water, transportation, transit, roads and highways, broadband, and power. It represents a multi-trillion-dollar market and a 20+ year megatrend in North America.

Citylitics transforms millions of documents across more than 40,000 cities, utilities, and public agencies into real-time market signals and high-value sales intelligence. Leading infrastructure vendors, engineering firms, and construction companies use the platform to identify and pre-position for major infrastructure opportunities earlier, helping them build relationships, shape project priorities, and influence scope before projects move to formal procurement.

Citylitics combines a network of AI agents, fine-tuned models, a proprietary infrastructure signals graph, and daily human-in-the-loop quality assurance workflows to deliver highly nuanced and reliable sales intelligence. The platform integrates seamlessly with CRMs, ERPs, and data lakes, embedding actionable insights directly into sales workflows so teams can prioritize the right pursuits and build stronger pipelines.

Our mission is to improve how infrastructure investments get made so critical needs can be addressed earlier and communities benefit from stronger, more resilient infrastructure.

Join Citylitics to work in a meaningful industry that will matter for decades to come while helping grow a company at the forefront of applied AI. We operate with a Results-Driven Mentality and a commitment to Raise The Bar, in a collaborative environment where Teamwork Makes the Dream Work as we tackle big challenges and celebrate wins together.

Who Are We Looking For?

Citylitics is looking for a Data Analyst to own our Custom Solutions practice. You'll scope and deliver client-specific data requests that don't fit our standard product.

You will partner directly with Sales, Customer Success, Product and leadership to triage incoming requests, assess feasibility before anything is promised to a client, query and validate data in BigQuery, and build the one-off dashboards or reports that answer a client's actual question.

This role fits someone analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, and disciplined about scope. You size up a vague ask fast, align stakeholders when it's over-committed, and educate clients on data availability and nuances while developing solution options to discuss with them. Once you've validated an approach with the customer, you hand the engineering work to the team. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need enough confidence in SQL and data structures to know what's realistic. You're also comfortable presenting data findings and methodology directly to clients and helping them interpret what the results mean. You move quickly and decisively, without overanalyzing.

This role is based in our downtown Toronto office and requires 3+ days in-office per week.

Vacancy Status: This position is for an existing and active vacancy that Citylitics is currently seeking to fill.

What Will You Accomplish?

Triage and Scope Custom Solution Requests

You will own the front door for custom solutions requests, deciding what's worth committing to before it reaches a client.

Responsibilities include:


Field new custom-solution requests from Sales and Customer Success as they come in (Slack, demo follow-ups, live calls)
Assess feasibility and turnaround before anything is committed to a client
Align stakeholders when a request is over-scoped or under-priced
Educate clients on data availability and nuances
Develop solution options to discuss with the client before committing to delivery


Query, Validate, and Build One-Off Deliverables

You will do the actual data work behind each request, once it's been scoped.

Responsibilities include:


Query BigQuery to test and validate client-specific hypotheses
Build or update lightweight dashboards (Looker, etc) for one-off client deliverables
Disambiguate against existing coverage to avoid duplicating work


Hand Off to Engineering Once Customer Validation Is Achieved

You validate the approach with the customer before engineering builds it.

Responsibilities include:


Write up findings and requirements clients or account teams can act on directly
Hand off anything requiring pipeline or scraper-level work to engineering, with a clear spec
Surface it immediately when a client's own criteria don't hold up
Other duties as assigned


Requirements

Must-Have Experience


2+ years of experience in data analysis, solutions consulting, business analysis, or a similar role
Strong SQL fluency (BigQuery a plus), comfortable self-serve querying
Scopes an ambiguous request before diving in and defines what "done" looks like from the start
Strong written and verbal communication for client-facing summaries
Comfortable working directly with clients or internal commercial teams under a fast turnaround pace
Comfortable presenting data findings and methodology directly to clients and helping them interpret results, not just retrieving data
Moves quickly and decisively, without overanalyzing


Nice-to-Have Experience


Enough SQL/notebook fluency to spec engineering work credibly (not to build it)
Prior consulting or client-facing analyst background
Familiarity with a BI/dashboarding tool (Looker, Tableau, etc.)


Benefits

Why Citylitics?


This is a rare opportunity to influence positive change within one of the biggest societal challenges of our generation: sustainable public infrastructure
You get to support a disruptive solution with a compelling value proposition into an industry that is eager to hear from you and in a market with no direct competition
We live at the cross section of infrastructure, scaleup and data science/AI. There is no other team like us in Toronto
There is no corporate bureaucracy here. You will accomplish more here in a few months than what you would in a few years at a large, entrenched technology company
We believe that Data and AI will play an outsized role in our future, so we equip every team member with access to Generative AI tools and our full Data Universe to enhance their productivity and encourage innovation through experimentation
We are proud to offer every CityZen in-role professional growth, skill-based development & learning, and internal promotion opportunities
We work hard, we play together, we win as a team! We are on a mission to solve infrastructure while savoring the moment and celebrating the little details along the way


Citylitics is an equal opportunity employer. We are passionate about providing a safe workplace where everyone is accepted and has the opportunity to grow with us. We are committed to making diversity and inclusivity part of our culture!

Description:
At OSL Retail Services, we believe people are the heart of everything we do, and it is an exciting time to be part of something special! Our momentum is growing, and is fueled by innovation, collaboration, and a shared entrepreneurial spirit that drives real results. Founded in 2012 in Mississauga, Ontario, OSL delivers customized sales solutions in retail, direct sales, and customer acquisition, all built on a foundation of integrity, respect, and passion. Our culture thrives on connection, purpose, and growth. If you’re looking for a place where your talents are valued, your ideas matter, and your career can grow, we’d love to meet you.




About The Role

We are currently seeking a Business Insights & Analytics Analyst. This role advances our analytical maturity in the fast-paced retail and direct sales industries. Going beyond standard reporting, the position focuses on uncovering what is happening, why it is happening, what is likely to happen next, and what the business should do about it. The ideal candidate is a curious, commercially minded analytical thinker who can translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations while partnering with business leaders to drive better decision-making.




What you’re responsible for:




Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, relationships, and business opportunities, going beyond standard reporting to uncover the “so what”
Translate analytical findings into clear insights, recommendations, and actions that support measurable business outcomes
Apply statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, and other advanced techniques to solve business problems
Identify opportunities to use predictive analytics and machine learning to understand drivers and anticipate future outcomes
Partner with business leaders to translate challenges into analytical questions, hypotheses, and actionable insights
Provide analytical thought partnership on strategic and operational decisions (forecasting, workforce planning, sales performance, customer behavior, and operational performance)
Leverage generative AI and AI-powered tools to accelerate data exploration, research, analysis, and insight generation
Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and other functions to understand needs and identify analytical opportunities
Develop dashboards, scorecards, and visualizations when appropriate to communicate insights and support decisions
Use tools such as SQL, Python, Domo, Power BI, Tableau, and other analytical technologies to explore, analyze, and communicate data
Partner with BI Developers and data teams to ensure analysis is based on accurate, reliable data and to translate requirements into scalable solutions




To join our team




Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Management Information Systems, or a related field
5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, financial analytics, market research, statistics, or a related analytical role (retail or data-driven environment preferred)
Strong SQL and data analysis skills, with experience applying statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, predictive analytics, or other advanced techniques
Experience with analytical and visualization tools such as Python, Domo, Power BI, Tableau, R, or similar
Familiarity with machine learning, generative AI, and AI-powered analytical tools, with interest in applying emerging technologies
Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with ambiguity and independently identify opportunities from data
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear, compelling insights for non-technical audiences




The salary for this role is $71K to $78K, with a yearly eligible 5% bonus. Your final compensation will reflect your years of experience and beyond the numbers, we’re proud to offer a holistic package that includes:

Generous time off: Start with 3 weeks of vacation.
Comprehensive benefits package: Includes medical, dental, vision and a health spending account.
Retirement support: Company-sponsored RRSP matching program to help build your financial future.
Award-winning culture: Proud to be one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies for 8 years running — now a Platinum Club member.
Invested in you: Structured employee development programs designed to help you thrive.




We’re committed to supporting your success every step of the way. What are the next steps?




The Interview Process

Step 1: If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first conversation with the recruiter.

Step 2: The next step is a virtual or in person interview with the hiring manager.

Step 3: The final step is an in-person interview with the hiring manager and extended team members.




Ready to bring your talent to a team where your impact matters? Apply today — we can’t wait to meet you!

  • Integration environment, incl. utilization in Logic Apps, Function Apps, Functions, and API Management.
  • Knowledge of DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) is a must.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Eagerness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, data-driven environment

Description:
Entreprise: GCL

Service: Strategic Execution

Catégories d’emplois: Poste permanent à temps plein

Modèle de travail: Hybride (2 jours au bureau)

Langue: Le ou la titulaire de ce poste travaille en anglais.

L’opportunité :

Nous sommes une coopérative canadienne de services financiers de premier plan engagée à promouvoir activement une société durable et résiliente, et notre équipe est essentielle au succès de cette stratégie. C’est pourquoi nos gens sont notre priorité. Nous offrons une culture d’entreprise vivante et des occasions de perfectionnement qui permettent à notre équipe d’exploiter tout son potentiel et de concrétiser notre raison d’être. Et le meilleur : vous travaillerez avec des personnes qui se soucient vraiment de vous, de notre clientèle et de nos collectivités.

L’analyste de données et de rapports, vous jouerez un rôle clé en soutenant la prise de décision liée aux projets et aux portefeuilles, grâce au développement, à l'administration et à l'optimisation de solutions de gestion des données, de reporting et de portefeuilles de projets. Vous concevrez et développerez des modèles de données, des solutions de reporting et des tableaux de bord interactifs répondant efficacement aux besoins de l'entreprise, afin de fournir des informations pertinentes pour la planification et la gestion stratégique, financière et de portefeuille. Nous vous invitons à nous rejoindre pour contribuer à façonner l'avenir de la gestion de projets au sein de notre organisation !

Comment vous créez un impact :


Administrer et assurer la maintenance de la plateforme de gestion de portefeuille de projets (PPM Pro), notamment la configuration du système, la gestion des flux de travail des utilisateurs, l’intégration des rapports ainsi que le soutien continu aux utilisateurs et à la plateforme.
Concevoir et développer des modèles de données basés sur SQL, des solutions de production de rapports et des tableaux de bord interactifs Power BI afin de soutenir l’intelligence d’affaires, l’analyse des données et la prise de décisions éclairées.
Collaborer étroitement avec les parties prenantes pour recueillir et documenter les exigences relatives aux données, aux tableaux de bord et aux rapports
Concevoir de manière autonome des solutions de rapports en mettant à profit les outils de l’entreprise (p. ex. MSTR, PowerBI) pour permettre une analyse et une communication narrative efficaces.
Procéder à des essais approfondis et à des pratiques de rapprochement sur les données et les indicateurs
Fournir un soutien à l’équipe d’analytique d’affaires pour la distribution en matière de communication des données et des rapports, y compris les essais et suggestions d’améliorations
Produire l’information et l’analytique pour soutenir les demandes opérationnelles ponctuelles.
Effectuer des analyses descriptives et diagnostiques de manière autonome en utilisant les méthodes recommandées.

Possède une solide compréhension des cycles de vie des projets ainsi que de leurs impacts sur les activités, les ressources et les résultats organisationnels

Vous possédez de 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en production de rapports de projet, en planification ou en gestion de portefeuille.

Vous avez de l’expérience avec les outils et langages d’analyse descriptive (MicroStrategy, PowerBI, Excel, SQL, SAS, Python, R, etc.).
Vous avez la capacité d'effectuer du codage ou de la programmation simple à des fins de rapports.
Une expérience de travail avec des outils de gestion et de planification de projets (p. ex., Planview, Clarity, Monday.com, Oracle, SAP, etc.) constitue un atout.
Vous avez fait des études postsecondaires en actuariat, en mathématiques, en statistique, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.
Vous possédez d’excellentes facultés de communication, de gestion du temps et de résolution de problèmes; attention aux détails.

Vous stimulez le changement et l’amélioration continue en vue de dépasser les attentes de la clientèle.
Vous faites appel à votre esprit critique afin de cerner les problèmes et de proposer des solutions de façon proactive.
Vos solides compétences en communication vous permettent de transmettre clairement les messages.
Vous faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe et vous partagez vos connaissances afin de soutenir vos pairs.

Si votre candidature est retenue, nous procéderons à la vérification de votre solvabilité et de vos antécédents judiciaires comme condition d’embauche.

Occasions de formation et de perfectionnement vous permettant de bâtir votre carrière.
Horaire de travail flexible et congés rémunérés pour subvenir à vos besoins et à ceux de votre famille.
Approche globale à l’égard de votre bien-être, programmes de santé physique et mentale et culture solidaire en milieu de travail.

Title: Senior Analyst
Description:
Agency

RAPP

Job Function

Data and Analytics

Job Subfunction

Data Science and Analytics

Job Description

WHO WE ARE:

We are TRACK – a member of the RAPP family– world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As a global, next-generation precision marketing agency we leverage data, creativity, technology, and empathy to foster client growth. We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations.  

We foster an inclusive workplace that emphasizes personal well-being.

How We Do It

At TRACK, our fearless super connectors help to create value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning. 

Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients. 

Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets. The TRACK team makes up 100 of those.

Your Role

As a Senior Analyst, you will be responsible for contributing to campaign reporting and dashboarding projects that help our clients understand how their CRM marketing is performing and help them answer strategic questions about their customers using data.

The Analyst leverages data visualization, data manipulation and statistics knowledge to inform our CRM experience and testing strategy and evaluate impact of our marketing programs.

We seek an individual who is detailed and data driven – and who will continuously seek out new ways of working focusing on opportunities for automation and the use of AI.

We’re looking for a true teammate – someone willing to lend a hand, no matter the ask, so that we can all succeed together. We love crafting exciting, conceptual campaigns, but we are also passionate about bringing excellence to the day-to-day brand communications that our clients rely on. That’s how we make ourselves invaluable and earn their trust.

This role requires navigating fast-paced, client-focused environments with multiple deadlines and conflicting priorities.

Your Responsibilities


Contribute and/or lead client reporting and analysis projects
Create campaign labeling and tracking
Create timely and accurate reporting
Deliver insights that inform strategy and drive measurable outcomes.
Work closely with internal teams, clients, and partners to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and actionable insights.
Analyze marketing and customer data to measure campaign performance, identify trends, and provide data-driven insights to optimize marketing strategies and improve ROI.
Build client-ready dashboards.
Manage your workload and identify risks.
Present complex analytical findings in a clear, engaging manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure high standards for data quality, integrity, and privacy across all client work.
Stay current on analytics tools, technologies (including AI) and industry trends; champion innovation and continuous improvement.


Required Skills


Undergraduate degree in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or related quantitative discipline
At least 3 years of analytics experience, preferably 1+ years with an Advertising, Marketing, Analytics, or Digital Media firm
Demonstrated experience with customer data, media & marketing measurement and CRM analytics. An understanding of core marketing analytics concepts including email, SMS and Web metrics.
Advanced Excel skills
Proficiency with analytics and data visualization tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Tableau, Power BI).
Advanced level SQL programming skills. Familiarity with Python.
Hands-on skills in statistical analysis and/or modeling (regression, segmentation, forecasting, etc.)
Extensive knowledge of database marketing principles and database structure
Presentation skills, data storytelling and the ability to simplify and package complex ideas for presentation and into client-ready documents.
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Natural curiosity and an aptitude for continuous learning.
Demonstrated ability to effectively maintain focus while working on multiple complex projects and to work with minimal supervision.


Our Perks


Generous PTO policy
Comprehensive health and dental plans
Paid personal and sick days
Birthday day off
Hybrid work model
Tuition reimbursement program
Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning
Telecoms monthly allowance
RRSP company match
Referral bonus


Our Hybrid Work Model

TRACK's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, with in-office attendance the rest of the week from our Toronto office.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy. The salary range for this role is $75,000-$85,000. Salary range 75,000-100,000

Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager. Our objective is to increase this requirement over time, and many of our agencies as well as Omnicom’s corporate group already require five days of in-office attendance.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Link to Recruitment Privacy Notice: https://www.omc.com/privacy-notice/

Title: Transportation Analyst
Description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Job Summary

The Transportation Analyst at McKesson Corporation plays a crucial role in optimizing our supply chain efficiency and cost-effectiveness by analyzing transportation data, identifying areas for improvement, and supporting strategic transportation initiatives.

Job Responsibilities


Collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets related to transportation costs, carrier performance, delivery times, and other key logistics metrics.
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for cost savings and service level improvements within the transportation network.
Develop and maintain transportation reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor operational effectiveness.
Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., supply chain, procurement, operations, IT) to implement transportation solutions and best practices.
Participate in projects aimed at improving transportation systems, processes, and technology.
Conduct root cause analysis for transportation issues and recommend corrective actions.
Stay informed of industry best practices, new technologies, and regulatory changes impacting transportation.



Job Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
2+ years of experience in transportation analysis, logistics, or supply chain operations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data.
Advanced skills in Power BI, DAX, SQL, Power Automate, IBM DB2/AS400 required
Experience with transportation management systems (TMS) and/or enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems is highly desirable.
Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Detail-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy.

Additionally, you will build and maintain stakeholder-focused dashboards that use data visualization to clearly highlight key trends and insights.

University Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Business or other relevant fields
1-2 years of experience in a similar role translating data into relevant and actionable business insights
The ability to define problems, collect and synthesize large amounts of data, form complex queries, establish facts and draw valid and actionable conclusions
Intermediate knowledge of SQL, BigQuery, Looker Studio
Basic knowledge of Python, R is an asset
Strong attention to detail and critical thinking skills to ensure data accuracy and quality
A curious mindset to continually explore new ideas and willingness to ask clarifying questions to navigate ambiguity, while being a strong self-starter
Strong communication, critical thinking and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate insights to both technical and non-technical audiences
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to stay on top of a dynamic and fast-moving business

The Blue Rewards Program is one of Canada’s most recognized loyalty programs, with over 8 million active collector accounts, representing more than half of all Canadian households. Contribute to all phases of campaign management (ideation, planning, targeting, measurement, recommendation) with a focus in pre-analysis and post-analysis

Present analysis results and recommendations in business language in different forums/meetings
Develop and maintain automated dashboards and reporting solutions
Automate and make process and tool improvement suggestions to drive operational efficiency

2-3 years of customer analysis / insight delivery experience in a complex data-driven organization

Expert in Microsoft Office (advanced Excel and PowerPoint)

Together, we work towards supporting optimal health outcomes and better quality of life.




Come Join Our Team!




Purpose:

In this role the Inventory Analyst will be the analytical foundation for our inventory and planning operations. Your work will significantly influence strategic and operational decisions by transforming raw data into insights, actionable dashboards, and supply chain strategies. You will help improve service levels, optimize inventory management, and enhance ERP data integrity.




Position: Inventory Analyst

Location: Ontario Medical Supply. – Mississauga (2785 Skymark Ave, Mississauga, ON L4W 4Y3),

No. of Positions: 1

ATR:#5188

Type: Full Time, Permanent

Salary: $53,200-$60,000/year




This job posting is for an existing vacancy




Job Responsibilities:

Data Analytics & Insights

Perform in-depth analysis on inventory, purchasing, demand forecasts, and supply chain KPIs.
Identify patterns, risks, and opportunities to improve efficiency, service levels, and cost performance.
Develop simulation and what-if analysis for key planning scenarios.




Reporting & Dashboards

Design, automate, and maintain dashboards (using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar) for inventory performance, order fulfillment, supplier reliability, and system optimization metrics.
Prepare weekly and monthly reporting packs for leadership, identifying key variances and root causes.




Planning Support

Support demand and replenishment planning by providing accurate, data-backed inputs.
Collaborate with purchasing and warehouse teams to align stock levels with demand trends and customer requirements.
Assist in safety stock analysis, min/max planning, and ABC categorization.




ERP & Master Data Integrity

Assist in ensuring the ERP system reflects accurate lead times, order quantities, and item attributes.
Partner with the Inventory and Purchasing Manager to enhance master data quality and maintain accurate planning parameters.




Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with warehouse, sales, finance, and customer service teams to align operations and mitigate supply chain risks.
Support ad hoc analysis requests from business stakeholders




Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business Analytics, or related field.
APICS/ASCM or other supply chain certification (CPIM, CSCP).
2–4 years of experience in supply chain analysis, inventory planning, or operations analytics.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, advanced formulas); experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
Experience working with ERP systems (preferably in the distribution or medical products sector).
Experience with SQL, Python, or other data tools.
Familiarity with demand planning, S&OP, or inventory optimization methodologies.




Skills:

Candidates must demonstrate strong communications skills (both verbally and written), organization, ability to --negotiate, good mathematical skills, sound judgment and initiative
Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and ability to turn data into decisions.
Must be a highly-motivated, self-driven person who can learn quickly and be comfortable in a fast-paced environment
Proficient in Microsoft Office Tools (excel, pivot tables, Power BI etc.) Use of SAP, WMS, Pronto etc.




Human Resources:

While we thank you for your interest, only select applicants will be contacted regarding the position.

Title: Leader, Business Intelligence
Description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/15/2026

This is a hybrid role with two days per week at Cisco’s Atlanta, Toronto or RTP offices. Alternate locations will be considered on an exception basis.

Members of the Finance organization at select locations will generally be expected to follow a hybrid work model, which includes two days of in-office attendance each week, with limited exceptions.

Meet The Team

The Market Insights team delivers the market intelligence behind executive decision-making at Cisco. We size markets, track the competitive landscape, and analyze customer behavior to inform where Cisco invests, builds, and competes.

We’re a team of analysts, data scientists, engineers, and market intelligence leaders focused on the practical application of data to hard business problems. Using proprietary data and machine learning, we surface new market opportunities and flag risks early. Every insight we produce is built to be acted on, so that resource allocation and product roadmaps rest on objective evidence rather than assumption.

Your Impact

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll sit between our data architecture and the strategic decisions it informs. Working with experts from the team, you’ll build the analytical solutions and dashboards that support the market insight analysis in the team and help visualize to give executives clear understanding into market performance — sizing opportunities, measuring how we’re performing against them, and translating what the data says into recommendations leaders can act on.

Responsibilities


Market Analysis: Run deep-dive analyses across large, disparate datasets — internal telemetry, third-party analyst data, public financial disclosures — to identify trends, anomalies, and growth opportunities in the global technology market.
Market Sizing & Forecasting: Build and maintain TAM models and forecasts for priority segments, tracking forecast accuracy and refining methodology over time.
Visualization: Develop and maintain interactive dashboards that turn complex datasets into insight an executive can absorb in two minutes.
Gen AI Integration: Apply LLMs and agentic workflows to synthesize unstructured sources — analyst reports, earnings calls, customer feedback — and to accelerate recurring reporting and narrative development.
Data Modeling: Architect and optimize the data models behind our analytical platforms for accuracy, scalability, and performance, and continuously improve the collection and reporting workflows that feed them.
Stakeholder Partnership: Work with Sales, Product Management, and Strategy to turn open business questions into analytical work, and own the reporting cadence that supports their planning.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field — Business Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science — or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years in business intelligence, data analysis, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
Hands-on experience with Tableau, Power BI, or a comparable visualization platform.
Strong grounding in data modeling, relational databases, and data warehousing.
Demonstrated experience applying LLMs to business problems — automating analysis, synthesizing unstructured data, or building agentic workflows.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, AWS Redshift, or Google BigQuery.
Python or R for statistical analysis and automation.


Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About The Business Analytics Team

The Business Analytics team unlocks strategic opportunities and enables Thumbtack to reach its full business potential. We own the metrics, dashboards, and forums that measure progress against company goals and build shared understanding of how the marketplace works. We run the deep-dive analyses that shape company strategy and team execution, and we use data to tell Thumbtack’s story to our team, our investors, and our Board. We are a tight-knit group that partners directly with leadership and cares as much about building a world-class team as we do about driving business impact.

About The Role

As a Sr. Data Scientist on Business Analytics, you’ll drive insights and action across the breadth of the marketplace, with a particular focus on conversion and monetization. You’ll be a steward of key company metrics and dashboards, and you’ll dive deep on the analytical questions most critical to Thumbtack’s success. You’ll partner with our leadership team to develop company strategy and goals, share performance updates with the Board, and work across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and Finance to turn analysis into decisions. This is a high-visibility role for someone who wants their work to change what the company does next.

What You’ll Do


Define, monitor, and report on the key metrics that measure Thumbtack’s success
Lead business performance analysis and reporting that surfaces emerging risks and opportunities for leadership
Conduct deep-dive analyses that answer the questions most critical to Thumbtack’s future strategy
Support and improve the company revenue forecasting model and the broader forecasting and planning process
Build and maintain the dashboards and self-serve tools that teams across the company rely on
Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and the leadership team to translate insight into action
Strengthen our data culture through peer collaboration, review, training, and coaching


In order to be successful, you must bring


6+ years of experience in a highly analytical role, preferably in tech; experience in a marketplace or two-sided platform business is a plus
Proficiency using SQL and Python or R to analyze large data sets
Exemplary analytical problem solving: a solid statistics foundation, strong business judgment, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the ability to synthesize insight from analysis
Experience partnering with executives to understand business needs and drive decisions
Strong communication skills — an attentive listener and a compelling explainer across technical and non-technical audiences
Experience with using AI to automate workflows and enable self-serve analytics
Experience with revenue modeling and forecasting, ideally in a high-growth or public company environment


Expected salary ranges


For candidates living in Ontario and British Columbia, the expected salary range for the role is currently $168,300.00 - $217,800.00.


Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Title: Senior Product Analyst - EA Sports FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note: this is a regular full-time (hybrid) role. Qualified applicants must be available to work in the Vancouver studio 3x per week. Canadian work authorization is required.

Data Analyst - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with production and product management partners to drive data-informed decisions within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data investigator, visualizer, and designer, helping to enhance the core experiences of our global player base.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modelling to evaluate feature design opportunities, assess risks, and support strategic investment decisions in UT.
Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets.
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners.
Explore user behavioral patterns to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies.
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making.


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making.
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis.
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners
Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies

Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.

Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis

Title: ICQA Data Analyst
Description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, you will be required to work autonomously, taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities


Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional work experience, or experience in MS Office, with an emphasis on Excel
Experience writing complex Excel VBA macros
Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.


Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. As a total compensation company, Amazon's package may include other elements such as sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, basic life & AD&D insurance), Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP), Deferred Profit Sharing Plan (DPSP), paid time off, and other resources to improve health and well-being. We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those interviewed will be advised as to hiring status.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada's top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Solutions team. In this role, you'll help build integrated, reliable, and scalable data solutions that support business decision-making across the organization. Working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Greenhouse, and Dayforce, you'll collaborate with business and technology partners to analyze data, support system integrations, improve data quality, and contribute to impactful enterprise-wide data initiatives. If you're curious, analytical, and enjoy working at the intersection of business, data, and technology, this could be an exciting next step in your career. Our offices operate on a hybrid model with three days per week in-office to support team collaboration.

What You Will Do


Analyze and profile data across enterprise systems to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Support the design and development of scalable data models and data structures for reporting, analytics, and integrations.
Collaborate with data engineers and application teams to define and validate data transformation rules.
Test and validate REST APIs, integrations, and data flows between business applications and data platforms.
Perform data quality, reconciliation, and validation activities to ensure accuracy and completeness of information.
Develop and execute test cases for data mappings, APIs, and end-to-end integration processes.
Document data models, mappings, integration requirements, and technical processes.
Participate in Agile delivery activities, including testing, defect resolution, and release validation.
Help identify opportunities to improve data usability, consistency, and operational efficiency across the organization.


What You Bring


3-5 years of experience in data analysis, business systems analysis, data integration, or a related technology role.
Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing relational data.
Experience working with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Dayforce, Greenhouse, or similar CRM, ATS, HRIS, or SaaS platforms.
Knowledge of relational data modelling concepts and data integration principles.
Experience working with and testing REST APIs, including JSON and API testing tools such as Postman.
Strong experience in data validation, reconciliation, and data quality analysis.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to document requirements, data mappings, testing activities, and technical processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and software development lifecycles.
Experience with Power BI or other reporting and analytics platforms.
Experience with Python or another scripting language.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern data technologies.
Experience working with HR, recruiting, CRM, finance, or other enterprise business data.
Financial services or other regulated industry experience.


The starting salary for this position is $110,000 - $130,000. The starting salary provided reflects the base salary for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation of this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment and selection process. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact talentacquisition@cclgroup.com if you require accommodation.

AI may be used to support certain stages of our screening & recruitment process. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment and decision-making.

Title: Senior Operations Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
Your opportunity

By joining the Kardium team, you can help make a difference in the lives of millions around the world. We have developed a ground-breaking medical device for the diagnosis and treatment of the most common heart rhythm disorder, atrial fibrillation – which can cause stroke, heart failure, and other heart-related complications.

Kardium’s mission is to deliver the best treatment for atrial fibrillation. To achieve this, we have developed The Globe® Pulsed Field System – we have a fantastic technical team that has developed a product with strong, unique, and customer-valued differentiators versus other solutions on the market. We have built connections with key opinion leaders who are already using the Globe System and are helping to tell our story.

We have obtained FDA approval and officially begun the commercial launch of the Globe® Pulsed Field System. This is a pivotal and exciting time in our journey, as we bring this life-changing technology to patients!

We are seeking an Operational Analyst who you will be responsible for delivering high-impact dashboards, metrics and reporting across various operational teams. You will play a critical role in enabling real-time operational visibility and data-informed decision-making, supporting both daily execution and strategic planning initiatives. The analyst will work cross-functionally with operations, purchasing, and quality teams, with a strong focus on data quality and continuity during our transition to Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP system.

Please note, this opportunity is a hybrid work arrangement, located in Burnaby, BC.

Meaningful work you will be a part of

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Develop and maintain critical operational metrics and key process indicators (KPIs) to support manufacturing, planning, and quality functions
Create and manage visual dashboards to provide real time insight into operational performance using tools such as Power BI and Excel
Provide analytical support for continuous improvement initiatives and projects to identify and prioritize optimization opportunities for cost reduction and performance improvements.
Query and extract relevant data from ERP and other data sources using SQL or other relevant tools.
Partner with cross-functional teams to identify data requirements and alignment with operational goals
Collaborate with stakeholders to develop scalable reporting frameworks and templates to support future growth.
Advise on data architecture and structure as systems evolve and new systems introduced, ensuring the right data is collected and accessible.
Lead initiatives to improve data quality and governance, identifying gaps and implementing data validation processes.
Train and support end-users in interpreting dashboard data and utilizing insights for decision-making.
Ensure data security and compliance with relevant regulations and company policies.


What You Bring To The Team

Our Kardium team is smart, creative, and passionate about developing cutting-edge medical devices to help improve people’s lives. We work in a collaborative environment based on trust and respect. We understand that only by working together can we solve what was thought unsolvable.

You will be successful in this role because you possess these attributes:


Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years experience in data analytics or reporting in a manufacturing or supply chain environment.
Advanced skills in Power BI, SQL and Excel.
Highly analytic and data driven with the ability to organize data and derive conclusions
Demonstrated experience building and maintaining dashboards and reporting systems used by cross-functional teams.
Strong understanding of operational process (manufacturing, supply chain) as well as key operations metrics (e.g., OEE, throughput, inventory turns, supplier performance).
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working with ERP systems (Microsoft D365 or equivalent is a strong asset).
Knowledge and experience working in the regulated manufacturing industry is an asset.


Compensation

Kardium has listed the total cash compensation range (base salary + 5% RRSP contribution) that we expect to pay applicants for this role, as of the time of this posting. Pay offered will be determined based on numerous relevant business and candidate factors including, for example, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, and business or organizational needs. For candidates with more or less experience than listed above, the pay range will be adjusted.

As a permanent employee, you will also participate in Kardium’s stock option plan.


$90,000 – 125,000 (CAD Annually)


Your Benefits & Well-being

The total cash we’ve listed for this position includes a base salary, plus an annual contribution to a Retirement Savings Plan account to help support your financial goals.

Comprehensive medical & dental coverage for all permanent employees – effective as of Day 1, with no waiting period.

Work-day flexibility – we offer a flexible work environment for daily working hours. In addition, we provide 3 personal days per year.

Support for you (and your dependents) overall well-being.

Family building – we provide top up for maternity leave, adoptive leave, and parental leave for non-birthing parents. Employees can also enroll in benefit coverage for fertility drug treatment.

Career progression and learning support.

Professional membership support.

Life at Kardium

What makes us a great place to work?


Our Purpose
Our People
Our Culture


At Kardium, we embrace diversity of background, experience, and perspective and we’re committed to inclusion and equity at every level. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of all communities.

We collaborate with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), as volunteer-led groups who share a common dimension of diversity and come together to provide support, education, and other opportunities across Kardium. Examples of our ERGs include Women ERG, Pride ERG, Race Ethnicity & Cultural Heritage (REACH) ERG, Truth & Reconciliation ERG, Persian ERG, Chinese ERG, Barangay Kardium (Filipino) ERG, Irish ERG, Brazilian ERG, and Early Career at Kardium ERG.

As part of your application, we encourage you to note if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations). There will be an optional section in the application form where you can provide this information to the recruitment team.

And our employees think we are great too – check out Glassdoor to learn more!

Title: Data Analyst II, Fraud
Description:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind.

Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders

About the Role:

As a Data Analyst, Fraud, you will be part of Remitly's Identity & Trust Analytics Team. Your mission is to leverage analytical methods to identify, prevent, and mitigate fraud impacting our customers globally. You will develop a deep understanding of Remitly's fraud detection systems, regional risk profiles, and operational processes to improve fraud defenses while maintaining a seamless experience for legitimate customers. You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Business Management, and Compliance to customize and optimize fraud models and workflows, integrating data from legacy and new platforms. This hybrid role requires 2–3 days per week in the Vancouver office.

You Will:


Become an expert on Remitly's fraud data (e.g. chargebacks, promo abuse, scams, onboarding risk).
Build data-driven models and dashboards to analyze and monitor fraud exposure, balancing customer experience with operational efficiency.
Collect, normalize, and analyze data from legacy prebriefs, transaction logs, and onboarding systems to identify fraud trends and behavior anomalies.
Partner with Business Management and Product to continuously improve customer verification, KYC, KYB and compliance workflows.
Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests to measure fraud control effectiveness and minimize false positives.
Develop and track risk metrics that quantify fraud exposure, policy compliance, and system performance.
Provide actionable insights and influence the development of fraud detection strategies, tools, and automation.


You Have:


3+ years in an analytics or fraud/risk analysis role within fintech, e-commerce, or digital payments.
Experience with fraud or trust analytics.
Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, economics, or another quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience).
Proficiency with SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large datasets (Python, R, or statistical modeling experience preferred).
Strong understanding of fraud taxonomies (chargebacks, identity theft, scams, onboarding risk, and promo abuse).
Demonstrated ability to distill business problems, develop hypotheses, perform analysis, and communicate clear recommendations.
Excellent data storytelling and communication skills; ability to translate complex findings into business decisions.


Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $125000. In Canada, Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits


Four weeks vacation
Health Benefits
Mental Health & Family Forming Benefits
RRSP plan with company match
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Life Insurance & Disability
Continuing education and travel benefits


Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster.Under the Company's current hybrid-work expectations, employees in this position work onsite Tuesday through Thursday each week. Additional onsite attendance may be required based on business needs, and the Company may modify its hybrid-work expectations from time to time. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an E-Verify Employer

At Remitly, we are dedicated to ensuring that our workplace offers equal employment opportunities to all employees and candidates, in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
